<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../models/User.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/AuthController.php';

class ProfileController {
    private $auth;
    private $userModel;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->auth = new AuthController();
        $this->auth->requireLogin();
        $this->userModel = new User();
    }
    
    /**
     * Get user profile
     */
    public function getProfile() {
        $nic = $_SESSION['nic'];
        return $this->userModel->findByNic($nic);
    }
    
    /**
     * Update full profile with all fields
     */
    public function updateProfile($name, $nic, $email, $computer_no, $mobile, $password = null) {
        $currentNic = $_SESSION['nic'];
        
        // Check if NIC is being changed and if it already exists
        if ($nic !== $currentNic && $this->userModel->nicExists($nic)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'NIC already registered to another user'];
        }
        
        // Check if email already exists (if changed)
        $userData = $this->userModel->findByNic($currentNic);
        if ($email !== $userData['email'] && $this->userModel->emailExists($email)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Email already registered to another user'];
        }
        
        // Check if computer number already exists (if changed)
        if ($computer_no !== $userData['computer_number'] && $this->userModel->computerNumberExists($computer_no)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Computer Number already registered to another user'];
        }
        
        // Update the profile
        $result = $this->userModel->updateFullProfile($currentNic, $name, $nic, $email, $computer_no, $mobile, $password);
        
        if ($result) {
            // Update session if NIC changed
            if ($nic !== $currentNic) {
                $_SESSION['nic'] = $nic;
            }
            $_SESSION['user_name'] = $name;
            $_SESSION['user_email'] = $email;
            $_SESSION['computer_number'] = $computer_no;
            
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Profile updated successfully!'];
        }
        
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Error updating profile'];
    }
}

File: src/helpers/roles.php

<?php
const ROLE_APPLICANT      = 1;
const ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN    = 2;
const ROLE_IMMEDIATE_BOSS = 3;
const ROLE_PERSONAL_FILE  = 4;
const ROLE_SUBJECT_CLERK  = 5;
const ROLE_BRANCH_OFFICER = 6;
const ROLE_FINAL_APPROVAL = 7;

function roleName($roleId) {
    $names = [
        1 => 'Applicant', 2 => 'Super Admin', 3 => 'Immediate Boss',
        4 => 'Personal File', 5 => 'Subject Clerk',
        6 => 'Branch Officer', 7 => 'Final Approval'
    ];
    return $names[(int)$roleId] ?? 'Applicant';
}

// Path (relative to baseUrl) where each role lands after login
function roleHomePath($roleId) {
    $paths = [
        1 => 'dashboard',
        2 => 'admin/dashboard.php',
        3 => 'admin/IB_Dashboard.php',
        4 => 'admin/PF_Dashboard.php',
        5 => 'admin/SC_dashboard.php',
        6 => 'admin/BO_Dashboard.php',
        7 => 'admin/FA_dashboard.php',
    ];
    return $paths[(int)$roleId] ?? 'dashboard';
}

function currentRoleId() {
    return (int)($_SESSION['role_id'] ?? 0);
}

// $path example: /admin/IB_Dashboard.php
function canAccessAdminPath($path) {
    $role = currentRoleId();
    if ($role < 2 || $role > 7) return false;   // applicants and unknown: no admin access
    if ($role === ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN) return true; // Super Admin can open everything

    $file = strtolower(basename($path));

    // Each dashboard belongs to exactly one role
    $dashboards = [
        'dashboard.php'    => 2,
        'ib_dashboard.php' => 3,
        'pf_dashboard.php' => 4,
        'sc_dashboard.php' => 5,
        'bo_dashboard.php' => 6,
        'fa_dashboard.php' => 7,
    ];
    if (isset($dashboards[$file])) {
        return $dashboards[$file] === $role;
    }

    // Files ending in _IB / -IB, _PF, _SC, _FA, _BO belong to that role
    $suffixRoles = ['ib' => 3, 'pf' => 4, 'sc' => 5, 'bo' => 6, 'fa' => 7];
    if (preg_match('/[_-](ib|pf|sc|fa|bo)\.php$/', $file, $m)) {
        return $suffixRoles[$m[1]] === $role;
    }

    // Shared admin files (no suffix): any staff role
    return true;
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/config.php';

class Application {
    private $conn;
    private $table = 'applications';
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->conn = getDBConnection();
    }
    
    /**
     * Create new application
     */
    public function create($nic, $quarterType) {
        $userStmt = $this->conn->prepare("SELECT computer_number FROM users WHERE nic = ? AND is_active = 1");
        $userStmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $userStmt->execute();
        $user = $userStmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
        $userStmt->close();

        if (!$user || empty($user['computer_number'])) {
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'A registered computer number is required.'];
        }

        $computerNo = $user['computer_number'];
        $applicationDate = date('Y-m-d');
        
        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$this->table} (
                nic, computer_no, quarter_type, application_date, status,
                application_status, submit_status, application_submitted_at
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', 'submitted', 'success', NOW())";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("ssss", $nic, $computerNo, $quarterType, $applicationDate);
        
        if ($stmt->execute()) {
            return [
                'success' => true,
                'computer_no' => $computerNo,
                'application_id' => $stmt->insert_id
            ];
        }
        return ['success' => false, 'error' => $this->conn->error];
    }
    
    /**
     * Get application by NIC
     */
    public function findByNic($nic) {
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE nic = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        return $result->fetch_assoc();
    }
    
    /**
     * Get application by computer number ONLY (for admin/search without NIC)
     */
    public function findByComputerNo($computerNo) {
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE computer_no = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $computerNo);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        return $result->fetch_assoc();
    }
    
    /**
     * Get application by computer number AND NIC (for user-specific search)
     */
    public function findByComputerNoAndNic($computerNo, $nic) {
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE computer_no = ? AND nic = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("ss", $computerNo, $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        return $result->fetch_assoc();
    }
    
    /**
     * Get application with waiting list position
     */
    public function getApplicationWithPosition($nic) {
        $application = $this->findByNic($nic);
        if (!$application) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Get waiting list position
          $pos_sql = "SELECT position FROM waiting_list WHERE nic = ? AND quarter_type = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1";
        
        $pos_stmt = $this->conn->prepare($pos_sql);
          $pos_stmt->bind_param("ss", $nic, $application['quarter_type']);
        $pos_stmt->execute();
        $pos_result = $pos_stmt->get_result();
        $position = null;
        
        if ($pos_row = $pos_result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $position = $pos_row['position'];
        }
        
        $application['position'] = $position;
        return $application;
    }
    /** Save or update the current user's latest draft preference. */
        public function savePreference($nic, $residenceType, $formLanguage = null) {
        // If a rejected application is waiting to be fixed, don't create a new draft.
        $rejCheck = $this->conn->prepare(
            "SELECT id FROM {$this->table}
             WHERE nic = ? AND application_status = 'rejected'
             ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1"
        );
        $rejCheck->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $rejCheck->execute();
        $rejRow = $rejCheck->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
        $rejCheck->close();
        if ($rejRow) {
            return (int)$rejRow['id'];
        }

        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare(
            "SELECT id FROM {$this->table} WHERE nic = ? AND application_status = 'draft' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1"
        );
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $existing = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
        $stmt->close();

        if ($existing) {
            if ($formLanguage !== null) {
                $sql = "UPDATE {$this->table} SET residence_type = ?, form_language = ? WHERE id = ?";
                $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
                $stmt->bind_param("ssi", $residenceType, $formLanguage, $existing['id']);
            } else {
                $sql = "UPDATE {$this->table} SET residence_type = ? WHERE id = ?";
                $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
                $stmt->bind_param("si", $residenceType, $existing['id']);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            $stmt->close();
            return $existing['id'];
        }

        $computerNo = '';
        $userStmt = $this->conn->prepare(
            "SELECT computer_number FROM users WHERE nic = ? AND is_active = 1"
        );
        $userStmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $userStmt->execute();
        $userRow = $userStmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
        $userStmt->close();
        if ($userRow && !empty($userRow['computer_number'])) {
            $computerNo = $userRow['computer_number'];
        }

        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$this->table} (
                    nic, computer_no, quarter_type, application_date,
                    residence_type, form_language, application_status, status, submit_status
                ) VALUES (?, ?, '', CURDATE(), ?, ?, 'draft', 'pending', 'pending')";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("ssss", $nic, $computerNo, $residenceType, $formLanguage);
        $stmt->execute();
        $newId = $stmt->insert_id;
        $stmt->close();
        return $newId;
    }

    /** Return the latest draft preference for a user, if one exists. */
    public function getPreference($nic) {
        $sql = "SELECT id, residence_type, form_language FROM {$this->table}
                WHERE nic = ? AND application_status = 'draft' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $row = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
        $stmt->close();
        return $row ?: null;
    }

        /**
     * Find an application by its primary key (used for resubmission).
     */
    public function findById($id) {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare(
            "SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1"
        );
        $stmt->bind_param("i", $id);
        $stmt->execute();
        $row = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
        $stmt->close();
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    /**
     * Find the latest rejected application for a NIC.
     */
    public function findRejectedByNic($nic) {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare(
            "SELECT * FROM {$this->table}
             WHERE nic = ? AND application_status = 'rejected'
             ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1"
        );
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $row = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
        $stmt->close();
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function __destruct() {
        if ($this->conn) {
            $this->conn->close();
        }
    }
}

                    marks_evaluated_at = NOW(), marks_evaluated_by_nic = VALUES(marks_evaluated_by_nic)";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param(
            'iiiiiiiiiis',
            $applicationId,
            $scores[0], $scores[1], $scores[2], $scores[3],
            $scores[4], $scores[5], $scores[6], $scores[7],
            $total, $nic
        );
        $result = $stmt->execute();
        $stmt->close();
        if (!$result) {
            return false;
        }

        $applicationStmt = $this->conn->prepare('UPDATE applications SET marks = ? WHERE id = ?');
        $applicationStmt->bind_param('ii', $total, $applicationId);
        $result = $applicationStmt->execute();
        $applicationStmt->close();
        if (!$result) {
            return false;
        }

        $waitingStmt = $this->conn->prepare("UPDATE waiting_list SET employee_marks = ? WHERE nic = (SELECT nic FROM applications WHERE id = ?) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1");
        $waitingStmt->bind_param('ii', $total, $applicationId);
        $result = $waitingStmt->execute();
        $waitingStmt->close();
        return $result;
    }

    public function applicationExists($applicationId) {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare('SELECT id FROM applications WHERE id = ?');
        $stmt->bind_param('i', $applicationId);
        $stmt->execute();
        $exists = $stmt->get_result()->num_rows === 1;
        $stmt->close();
        return $exists;
    }

    public function __destruct() {
        if ($this->conn) {
            $this->conn->close();
        }
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/config.php';

class Complaint {
    private $conn;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->conn = getDBConnection();
    }

    public function create($nic, $details, $relatedIssue) {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("INSERT INTO complaints (user_id, complaints, related_issue, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'Pending')");
        $stmt->bind_param('sss', $nic, $details, $relatedIssue);
        $saved = $stmt->execute();
        $complaintId = $stmt->insert_id;
        $stmt->close();

        if (!$saved) {
            return false;
        }

        $notificationMessage = 'New complaint received regarding: ' . $relatedIssue;
        $notificationStmt = $this->conn->prepare("INSERT INTO notifications (nic, title, message, is_read) SELECT nic, 'New Complaint', ?, 0 FROM users WHERE role = 'subject_clerk'");
        $notificationStmt->bind_param('s', $notificationMessage);
        $notificationStmt->execute();
        $notificationStmt->close();

        return $complaintId;
    }

    public function __destruct() {
        if ($this->conn) {
            $this->conn->close();
        }
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/config.php';

class DropdownModel {
    private $conn;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->conn = getDBConnection();
    }

    /**
     * Shared helper for the simple lookup tables.
     * Returns rows as: id, name (label in the chosen language), value (English name stored in the DB).
     * Table and column names are fixed in the methods below - never pass user input here.
     */
    private function getLookup($table, $column, $columnSi, $language = 'en') {
        $langField = $language === 'si' ? $columnSi : $column;
        $sql = "SELECT id, {$langField} AS name, {$column} AS value
                FROM {$table} WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC";
        $result = $this->conn->query($sql);
        return $result->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
    }

    /**
     * Get all active quarter types
     */
    public function getQuarterTypes($language = 'en') {
        return $this->getLookup('quarter_types', 'type_name', 'type_name_si', $language);
    }

    /**
     * Get all active designations
     */
    public function getDesignations($language = 'en') {
        return $this->getLookup('designations', 'designation_name', 'designation_name_si', $language);
    }

    /**
     * Get all active sub-departments
     */
    public function getSubDepartments($language = 'en') {
        return $this->getLookup('sub_departments', 'dept_name', 'dept_name_si', $language);
    }

    /**
     * Get all active districts
     */
    public function getDistricts($language = 'en') {
        return $this->getLookup('districts', 'district_name', 'district_name_si', $language);
    }

    /**
     * Get all active quarter locations (applied_quarter_location)
     */
    public function getQuarterLocations($language = 'en') {
        return $this->getLookup('quarter_locations', 'location_name', 'location_name_si', $language);
    }

    /**
     * Get all active work stations (applicant_current_work_station)
     */
    public function getWorkStations($language = 'en') {
        return $this->getLookup('work_stations', 'station_name', 'station_name_si', $language);
    }

    /**
     * Get all active salary account branches (applicant_salary_account_branch)
     */
    public function getSalaryAccountBranches($language = 'en') {
        return $this->getLookup('salary_account_branches', 'branch_name', 'branch_name_si', $language);
    }

    /**
     * Get all active personal file offices (applicant_personal_file_office)
     */
    public function getPersonalFileOffices($language = 'en') {
        return $this->getLookup('personal_file_offices', 'office_name', 'office_name_si', $language);
    }

    /**
     * Get all active quarters (applied_quarter_number). The form filters them
     * by the selected location in JavaScript.
     */
    public function getQuarters() {
        $sql = "SELECT quarter_number, location_name, quarter_type
                FROM quarters WHERE is_active = 1
                ORDER BY sort_order ASC, quarter_number ASC";
        $result = $this->conn->query($sql);
        return $result->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
    }

    /**
     * Get all active quarter numbers (applied_quarter_number dropdown)
     */
    public function getQuarterNumbers($language = 'en') {
        $sql = "SELECT id, quarter_number AS name, quarter_number AS value
                FROM quarter_numbers WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC";
        $result = $this->conn->query($sql);
        return $result->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
    }

    public function __destruct() {
        if ($this->conn) {
            $this->conn->close();
        }
    }
}

        $stmt->bind_param("sss", $nic, $title, $message);

        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        return $result->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
    }
    
    /**
     * Get unread count
     */
    public function getUnreadCount($nic) {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {$this->table} WHERE nic = ? AND is_read = 0";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
        return $row['count'] ?? 0;
    }
    
    /**
     * Mark as read
     */
    public function markAsRead($id, $nic) {

        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("is", $id, $nic);
        return $stmt->execute();
    }
    
    /**

class Offer {
    private $conn;
    private $table = 'respond_to_offer';
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->conn = getDBConnection();
    }
    
    /**
     * Get active offer for user
     */
    public function getActiveOffer($nic) {
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM {$this->table} 
                WHERE nic = ? AND status IN ('approved', 'accepted') 
                ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        return $result->fetch_assoc();
    }

    public function getByNic($nic) {
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE nic = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $offers = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
        $stmt->close();
        return $offers;
    }
    
    /**
     * Accept offer
     */
    public function accept($id, $nic) {
        $sql = "UPDATE {$this->table} SET status = 'accepted' WHERE id = ? AND nic = ?";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("is", $id, $nic);
        $saved = $stmt->execute() && $stmt->affected_rows > 0;
        $stmt->close();
        return $saved;
    }
    
    /**
     * Postpone offer
     */
    public function postpone($id, $nic) {
        $sql = "UPDATE {$this->table} SET created_at = NOW(), status = 'pending' WHERE id = ? AND nic = ?";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("is", $id, $nic);
        $saved = $stmt->execute() && $stmt->affected_rows > 0;
        $stmt->close();
        return $saved;
    }
    
    /**
     * Deny offer
     */
    public function deny($id, $nic) {
        $sql = "DELETE FROM {$this->table} WHERE id = ? AND nic = ?";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("is", $id, $nic);
        $saved = $stmt->execute() && $stmt->affected_rows > 0;
        $stmt->close();
        return $saved;
    }
    
    public function __destruct() {
        if ($this->conn) {
            $this->conn->close();
        }
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/config.php';

class User {
    private $conn;
    private $table = 'users';
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->conn = getDBConnection();
    }
    
    /**
     * Find user by NIC
     */
    public function findByNic($nic) {
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE nic = ? AND is_active = 1";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        return $result->fetch_assoc();
    }
    
    /**
     * Find user by email
     */
    public function findByEmail($email) {
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE email = ? AND is_active = 1";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $email);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        return $result->fetch_assoc();
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if NIC exists
     */
    public function nicExists($nic) {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {$this->table} WHERE nic = ?";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
        return $row['count'] > 0;
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if email exists
     */
    public function emailExists($email) {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {$this->table} WHERE email = ?";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $email);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
        return $row['count'] > 0;
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if computer number exists
     */
    public function computerNumberExists($computerNumber) {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {$this->table} WHERE computer_number = ?";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $computerNumber);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
        return $row['count'] > 0;
    }
    
    /**
     * Create new user with bcrypt password
     */
    public function create($data) {
        // Hash password with bcrypt (cost factor 12)
        $hashedPassword = password_hash($data['password'], PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12]);
        
        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$this->table} (nic, name, email, computer_number, mobile, password, role_id) 
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("ssssss", 
            $data['nic'], 
            $data['name'], 
            $data['email'], 
            $data['computer_number'], 
            $data['mobile'], 
            $hashedPassword
        );
        
        if ($stmt->execute()) {
            return [
                'success' => true,
                'id' => $stmt->insert_id
            ];
        }
        return [
            'success' => false, 
            'error' => $this->conn->error
        ];
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify login credentials using bcrypt
     */
    public function verifyLogin($nic, $password) {
        $user = $this->findByNic($nic);
        
        if (!$user) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Verify password using bcrypt
        if (password_verify($password, $user['password'])) {
            // Check if password needs rehashing
            if (password_needs_rehash($user['password'], PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12])) {
                $newHash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12]);
                $this->updatePassword($nic, $newHash);
            }
            return $user;
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    /**
     * Update user password
     */
    public function updatePassword($nic, $hashedPassword) {
        $sql = "UPDATE {$this->table} SET password = ? WHERE nic = ?";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("ss", $hashedPassword, $nic);
        return $stmt->execute();
    }
    
    /**
     * Update user profile (simple version - keeps existing signature)
     */
    public function updateProfile($nic, $name, $email, $mobile = null) {
        $sql = "UPDATE {$this->table} SET name = ?, email = ?" . 
               ($mobile ? ", mobile = ?" : "") . 
               " WHERE nic = ?";
        
        if ($mobile) {
            $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->bind_param("ssss", $name, $email, $mobile, $nic);
        } else {
            $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->bind_param("sss", $name, $email, $nic);
        }
        
        return $stmt->execute();
    }
    
    /**
     * NEW: Update full user profile with all fields including password
     * This method is called by the enhanced edit_profile.php
     */
    public function updateFullProfile($currentNic, $name, $nic, $email, $computer_no, $mobile, $password = null) {
        if ($password && !empty($password)) {
            // With password update
            $hashedPassword = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12]);
            $sql = "UPDATE {$this->table} SET 
                    name = ?, 
                    nic = ?, 
                    email = ?, 
                    computer_number = ?, 
                    mobile = ?, 
                    password = ? 
                    WHERE nic = ?";
            $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->bind_param("sssssss", $name, $nic, $email, $computer_no, $mobile, $hashedPassword, $currentNic);
        } else {
            // Without password update
            $sql = "UPDATE {$this->table} SET 
                    name = ?, 
                    nic = ?, 
                    email = ?, 
                    computer_number = ?, 
                    mobile = ? 
                    WHERE nic = ?";
            $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->bind_param("ssssss", $name, $nic, $email, $computer_no, $mobile, $currentNic);
        }
        
        return $stmt->execute();
    }
    
    /**
     * Rate limit login attempts
     */
    public function getLoginAttempts($nic) {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM login_attempts 
                WHERE nic = ? AND attempt_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
        return $row['count'] ?? 0;
    }
    
    /**
     * Log login attempt
     */
    public function logLoginAttempt($nic, $ip, $success) {
        // Create login_attempts table if not exists
        $this->createLoginAttemptsTable();
        
        $sql = "INSERT INTO login_attempts (nic, ip_address, success, attempt_time) 
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, NOW())";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("ssi", $nic, $ip, $success);
        return $stmt->execute();
    }
    
    /**
     * Create login attempts table
     */
    private function createLoginAttemptsTable() {
        $sql = "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS login_attempts (
            id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
            nic VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
            ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
            success TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
            attempt_time TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            INDEX idx_nic_time (nic, attempt_time)
        )";
        $this->conn->query($sql);
    }
    
    public function __destruct() {
        if ($this->conn) {
            $this->conn->close();
        }
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/config.php';

class WaitingList {
    private $conn;
    private $table = 'waiting_list';
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->conn = getDBConnection();
    }
    
    /**
     * Add applicant to waiting list
     */
    public function add($nic, $quarterType, $position) {
        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$this->table} (nic, position, quarter_type, applied_date) VALUES (?, ?, ?, CURDATE())";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("sis", $nic, $position, $quarterType);
        return $stmt->execute();
    }
    
    /**
     * Get position for applicant
     */
    public function getPosition($nic, $quarterType = null) {
        if ($quarterType !== null) {
            $sql = "SELECT position FROM {$this->table} WHERE nic = ? AND quarter_type = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1";
            $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->bind_param("ss", $nic, $quarterType);
        } else {
            $sql = "SELECT position FROM {$this->table} WHERE nic = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1";
            $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        }
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
        return $row ? $row['position'] : null;
    }

    public function getLatestForNic($nic) {
        $sql = "SELECT position, quarter_type, applied_date, designation_score, employee_marks
                FROM {$this->table} WHERE nic = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $stmt->execute();
        $row = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
        $stmt->close();
        return $row;
    }
    
    /**
     * Get waiting list with calculated positions
     */
    public function getWaitingListWithPositions() {
        $sql = "SELECT 
                    a1.nic,
                    a1.quarter_type,
                    a1.applied_date,
                    a1.employee_marks,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
                     FROM waiting_list a2 
                             WHERE a2.quarter_type = a1.quarter_type AND ((a2.applied_date < a1.applied_date)
                                OR (a2.applied_date = a1.applied_date AND a2.employee_marks > a1.employee_marks)
                                OR (a2.applied_date = a1.applied_date AND a2.employee_marks = a1.employee_marks AND a2.id <= a1.id))
                    ) AS position
                FROM waiting_list a1 
                ORDER BY position ASC";
        $result = $this->conn->query($sql);
        return $result->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
    }
    
    public function __destruct() {
        if ($this->conn) {
            $this->conn->close();
        }
    }
}
?>

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// Database connection configuration[cite: 5]
$host = 'localhost';
$dbname = 'admin_dashboard_db';
$username = 'root';
$password = '';

$message = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    try {
        $pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=$host;dbname=$dbname;charset=utf8mb4", $username, $password);
        $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        $sql = "INSERT INTO allocated_quarters (nic, computer_no, quarter_no, quarter_name, quarter_location, quarter_type, resident_name, designation, workplace, allocated_date, other) 
                VALUES (:nic, :computerNo, :quarterNo, :quarterName, :quarterLocation, :quarterType, :residentName, :designation, :workplace, :allocatedDate, :other)";
        $stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([
            ':nic' => $_POST['nic'] ?? '',
            ':computerNo' => $_POST['computerNo'] ?? '',
            ':quarterNo' => $_POST['quarterNo'] ?? '',
            ':quarterName' => $_POST['quarterName'] ?? '',
            ':quarterLocation' => $_POST['quarterLocation'] ?? '',
            ':quarterType' => $_POST['quarterType'] ?? '',
            ':residentName' => $_POST['residentName'] ?? '',
            ':designation' => $_POST['designation'] ?? '',
            ':workplace' => $_POST['workplace'] ?? '',
            ':allocatedDate' => $_POST['allocatedDate'] ?? '',
            ':other' => $_POST['other'] ?? 'None'
        ]);

        // Data successfully save zalyanantara allocated_quarters.php page var redirect hoil[cite: 5]
        header("Location: allocated_quarters.php");
        exit();

    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $message = "Error: " . $e->getMessage();
    }
}

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }

<?php
/**
 * Add Maintenance Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways (database-backed)
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Add Maintenance Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways Admin";

$userData = [
    'name' => 'Subject Clerk',
    'role' => 'Sri Lanka Railways - AOT',
    'initials' => 'SC'
];

$error = '';

$old = [
    'quarter_number'        => '',
    'quarter_name'          => '',
    'location_name'         => '',
    'quarter_type'          => '',
    'maintenance_status'    => 'Under Maintenance',
    'last_maintenance_date' => '',
    'notes'                 => '',
];

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    foreach ($old as $k => $v) {
        if (isset($_POST[$k])) $old[$k] = trim((string)$_POST[$k]);
    }

    if ($old['quarter_number'] === '' || $old['location_name'] === '' || $old['quarter_type'] === '') {
        $error = 'Quarter No, Location and Quarter Type are required.';
    } else {
        $conn = getDBConnection();
        $stmt = $conn->prepare(
            "INSERT INTO maintenance
                (quarter_number, quarter_name, location_name, quarter_type,
                 maintenance_status, last_maintenance_date, notes)
             VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)"
        );
        $lastMaint = $old['last_maintenance_date'] !== '' ? $old['last_maintenance_date'] : null;
        $notes = $old['notes'] !== '' ? $old['notes'] : null;
        $stmt->bind_param(
            "sssssss",
            $old['quarter_number'],
            $old['quarter_name'],
            $old['location_name'],
            $old['quarter_type'],
            $old['maintenance_status'],
            $lastMaint,
            $notes
        );
        if ($stmt->execute()) {
            $stmt->close();
            $conn->close();
            header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/maintenance.php'));
            exit;
        }
        $error = 'Insert failed: ' . $conn->error;
        $stmt->close();
        $conn->close();
    }
}

<?php
/**
 * Add Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways Admin
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Add Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways Admin";

$userData = [
    'name' => 'Subject Clerk',
    'role' => 'Sri Lanka Railways - AOT',
    'initials' => 'SC'
];

$error = '';

// Preserve old input on validation error
$old = [
    'quarter_number'          => '',
    'quarter_name'            => '',
    'location_name'           => '',
    'quarter_address'         => '',
    'quarter_type'            => '',
    'quarter_division'        => '',
    'quarter_ownership'       => '',
    'quarter_area'            => '',
    'quarter_assessment_rent' => '',
    'quarter_status'          => '',
    'has_electricity'         => 1,
    'has_water'               => 1,
];

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    foreach ($old as $k => $v) {
        if (in_array($k, ['has_electricity', 'has_water'], true)) {
            $old[$k] = isset($_POST[$k]) ? 1 : 0;
        } elseif (isset($_POST[$k])) {
            $old[$k] = $_POST[$k];
        }
    }

    $old['quarter_number']          = trim((string)$old['quarter_number']);
    $old['quarter_name']            = trim((string)$old['quarter_name']);
    $old['location_name']           = trim((string)$old['location_name']);
    $old['quarter_address']         = trim((string)$old['quarter_address']);
    $old['quarter_type']            = trim((string)$old['quarter_type']);
    $old['quarter_division']        = trim((string)$old['quarter_division']);
    $old['quarter_ownership']       = trim((string)$old['quarter_ownership']);
    $old['quarter_area']            = trim((string)$old['quarter_area']);
    $old['quarter_assessment_rent'] = (float)$old['quarter_assessment_rent'];
    $old['quarter_status']          = (string)$old['quarter_status'];

    if ($old['quarter_number'] === '' || $old['location_name'] === '' || $old['quarter_type'] === '') {
        $error = 'Quarter No., Location, and Quarter Type are required.';
    } elseif (!in_array($old['quarter_status'], ['Available', 'Occupied', 'Under Maintenance'], true)) {
        $error = 'Please select a valid quarter status.';
    } else {
        $conn = getDBConnection();
        $stmt = $conn->prepare(
            "INSERT INTO quarters
                (quarter_number, quarter_name, location_name, quarter_address,
                 quarter_type, quarter_division, quarter_ownership, quarter_area,
                 quarter_assessment_rent, quarter_status, has_electricity, has_water,
                 is_active, sort_order)
             VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,1,0)"
        );
        $stmt->bind_param(
            "ssssssssdsii",
            $old['quarter_number'],
            $old['quarter_name'],
            $old['location_name'],
            $old['quarter_address'],
            $old['quarter_type'],
            $old['quarter_division'],
            $old['quarter_ownership'],
            $old['quarter_area'],
            $old['quarter_assessment_rent'],
            $old['quarter_status'],
            $old['has_electricity'],
            $old['has_water']
        );

        if ($stmt->execute()) {
            $stmt->close();
            $conn->close();
            header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/quarters_list.php'));
            exit;
        }
        $error = 'Insert failed: ' . $conn->error;
        $stmt->close();
        $conn->close();
    }
}

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

/**
 * Add New System User - Sri Lanka Railways
 * Inserts a staff user (role_id 2-7) into the real `users` table.
 */
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

$pageTitle = "Add System User - Sri Lanka Railways";
$hide_admin_extras = true;

$error_message = '';

// Form defaults
$nic         = '';
$computer_no = '';
$full_name   = '';
$email       = '';
$phone       = '';
$role_id     = '';

// Role map (matches src/helpers/roles.php; applicant excluded)
$roles = [
    2 => 'Super Admin',
    3 => 'Immediate Boss',
    4 => 'Personal File',
    5 => 'Subject Clerk',
    6 => 'Branch Officer',
    7 => 'Final Approval',
];

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $nic         = trim($_POST['nic'] ?? '');
    $computer_no = trim($_POST['computer_no'] ?? '');
    $full_name   = trim($_POST['full_name'] ?? '');
    $email       = trim($_POST['email'] ?? '');
    $phone       = trim($_POST['phone'] ?? '');
    $role_id     = (int) ($_POST['role_id'] ?? 0);
    $password    = $_POST['password'] ?? '';
    $confirm     = $_POST['confirm_password'] ?? '';

    // Validation
    if ($nic === '' || $computer_no === '' || $full_name === '' || $email === '' || $phone === '' || $password === '' || $role_id === 0) {
        $error_message = 'Please fill in all required fields.';
    } elseif ($password !== $confirm) {
        $error_message = 'Passwords do not match! Please check again.';
    } elseif (!filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
        $error_message = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
    } elseif (!array_key_exists($role_id, $roles)) {
        $error_message = 'Please select a valid staff role.';
    } else {
        $conn = getDBConnection();

        // Uniqueness
        $chk = $conn->prepare("SELECT nic FROM users WHERE nic = ? LIMIT 1");
        $chk->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $chk->execute();
        $nicTaken = $chk->get_result()->num_rows > 0;
        $chk->close();

        $chk2 = $conn->prepare("SELECT nic FROM users WHERE email = ? LIMIT 1");
        $chk2->bind_param("s", $email);
        $chk2->execute();
        $emailTaken = $chk2->get_result()->num_rows > 0;
        $chk2->close();

        $chk3 = $conn->prepare("SELECT nic FROM users WHERE computer_number = ? LIMIT 1");
        $chk3->bind_param("s", $computer_no);
        $chk3->execute();
        $compTaken = $chk3->get_result()->num_rows > 0;
        $chk3->close();

        if ($nicTaken) {
            $error_message = 'This NIC is already registered.';
        } elseif ($emailTaken) {
            $error_message = 'This email is already registered.';
        } elseif ($compTaken) {
            $error_message = 'This computer number is already registered.';
        } else {
            $hash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12]);

            $insert = $conn->prepare(
                "INSERT INTO users (nic, name, email, password, computer_number, mobile, role_id)
                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)"
            );
            $insert->bind_param("ssssssi", $nic, $full_name, $email, $hash, $computer_no, $phone, $role_id);

            if ($insert->execute()) {
                $insert->close();
                $conn->close();
                $_SESSION['flash_message'] = 'New system user added successfully!';
                header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/system-users.php'));
                exit;
            } else {
                $error_message = 'Insert failed: ' . $conn->error;
                $insert->close();
            }
        }

        $conn->close();
    }
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

    <div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full">

        if (p1 !== p2) {
            alert("Passwords do not match! Please check again.");
            document.getElementById('confirmPassword').focus();

            return false;

<?php
/**
 * Add New Applicant - Sri Lanka Railways
 * Inserts into the real `users` table (role_id = 1).
 */
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

$pageTitle = "Add New User - Sri Lanka Railways Admin";
$hide_admin_extras = true;

$success_message = '';
$error_message   = '';

$name        = '';
$nic         = '';
$email       = '';
$computer_no = '';
$mobile      = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $name             = trim($_POST['name'] ?? '');
    $nic              = trim($_POST['nic'] ?? '');
    $email            = trim($_POST['email'] ?? '');
    $computer_no      = trim($_POST['computer_no'] ?? '');
    $mobile           = trim($_POST['mobile'] ?? '');
    $password         = $_POST['password'] ?? '';
    $confirm_password = $_POST['confirm_password'] ?? '';

    if ($name === '' || $nic === '' || $email === '' || $computer_no === '' || $mobile === '' || $password === '') {
        $error_message = 'Please fill in all required fields.';
    } elseif ($password !== $confirm_password) {
        $error_message = 'Passwords do not match! Please check again.';
    } elseif (!filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
        $error_message = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
    } elseif (!preg_match('/^[0-9]{9,12}$/', $nic)) {
        $error_message = 'NIC must be 9 to 12 digits.';
    } elseif (!preg_match('/^[0-9]{10}$/', $mobile)) {
        $error_message = 'Mobile number must be 10 digits.';
    } else {
        $conn = getDBConnection();

        $chk = $conn->prepare("SELECT nic FROM users WHERE nic = ? LIMIT 1");
        $chk->bind_param("s", $nic);
        $chk->execute();
        $nicTaken = $chk->get_result()->num_rows > 0;
        $chk->close();

        $chk2 = $conn->prepare("SELECT nic FROM users WHERE email = ? LIMIT 1");
        $chk2->bind_param("s", $email);
        $chk2->execute();
        $emailTaken = $chk2->get_result()->num_rows > 0;
        $chk2->close();

        $chk3 = $conn->prepare("SELECT nic FROM users WHERE computer_number = ? LIMIT 1");
        $chk3->bind_param("s", $computer_no);
        $chk3->execute();
        $compTaken = $chk3->get_result()->num_rows > 0;
        $chk3->close();

        if ($nicTaken) {
            $error_message = 'This NIC is already registered.';
        } elseif ($emailTaken) {
            $error_message = 'This email is already registered.';
        } elseif ($compTaken) {
            $error_message = 'This computer number is already registered.';
        } else {
            $hash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12]);

            $insert = $conn->prepare(
                "INSERT INTO users (nic, name, email, password, computer_number, mobile, role_id)
                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)"
            );
            $insert->bind_param("ssssss", $nic, $name, $email, $hash, $computer_no, $mobile);

            if ($insert->execute()) {
                $insert->close();
                $conn->close();
                $_SESSION['flash_message'] = 'New user record added successfully!';
                header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/view_users.php'));
                exit;
            } else {
                $error_message = 'Insert failed: ' . $conn->error;
                $insert->close();
            }
        }

        $conn->close();
    }
}

<?php
/**
 * Allocated Quarters List - Sri Lanka Railways
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Allocated Quarters List - Sri Lanka Railways Admin";

// Database configuration
$host = 'localhost';$dbname = 'admin_dashboard_db';
$username = 'root';$password = '';

// Initialize $quarters array to prevent undefined variable / count() error$quarters = [];

try {
    $pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=$host;dbname=$dbname;charset=utf8mb4", $username, $password);$pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    die("Database connection failed: " . $e->getMessage());
}

// Handle Delete Request with System Message Generation[cite: 1]
if (isset($_GET['delete_id'])) {
    $deleteId =$_GET['delete_id'];
    try {
        $stmt =$pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM allocated_quarters WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$deleteId]);
        header("Location: allocated_quarters.php?msg=deleted");
        exit();
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        header("Location: allocated_quarters.php?msg=error");
        exit();
    }
}

// Handle Search Filter & Order by ASC so new records appear at the bottom (anthimata)
$search = trim($_GET['search'] ?? '');
if ($search !== '') {
    $stmt = $pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM allocated_quarters WHERE nic LIKE ? OR computer_no LIKE ? OR quarter_no LIKE ? OR quarter_name LIKE ? OR quarter_location LIKE ? OR resident_name LIKE ? OR designation LIKE ? OR workplace LIKE ? ORDER BY id ASC");
    $searchTerm = "%" . $search . "%";
    $stmt->execute([$searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm]);
} else {
    $stmt = $pdo->query("SELECT * FROM allocated_quarters ORDER BY id ASC");
}
$quarters = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

// System Message Handling[cite: 1]
$message = '';$messageType = 'success';
if (isset($_GET['msg'])) {
    if ($_GET['msg'] === 'deleted') {$message = "Record deleted successfully!";
        $messageType = 'success';
    } elseif ($_GET['msg'] === 'error') {$message = "Error: Failed to delete the record. Please try again.";
        $messageType = 'error';
    }
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';

<script>
    function openDeleteModal(id) {
        const deleteUrl = `allocated_quarters.php?delete_id=${id}`;
        document.getElementById('confirmDeleteBtn').setAttribute('href', deleteUrl);
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeDeleteModal() {
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').style.display = 'none';
    }
</script>

                $filtered = array_filter($pendingData, function($item) use ($searchTermLower) {

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$message = "";
$messageType = "success";
$conn = getDBConnection();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $action = $_POST['action'] ?? '';
    $id = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
    $reason = trim((string)($_POST['reason'] ?? ''));

    if ($id && ($action === 'approve' || ($action === 'reject' && $reason !== ''))) {
        $fileStatus = $action === 'approve' ? 'approved' : 'rejected';
        $fileReason = $action === 'reject' ? $reason : null;
        // Approve -> continues to Subject Clerk. Reject -> goes BACK TO THE IMMEDIATE BOSS (not the applicant).
        $applicationStatus = $action === 'approve' ? 'pending_clerk' : 'returned_to_boss';
        $stmt = $conn->prepare(
            "UPDATE applications
             SET file_status = ?, file_reason = ?, application_status = ?
             WHERE id = ? AND boss_status = 'approved'
               AND file_status = 'pending' AND is_resubmission = 0"
        );
        $stmt->bind_param('sssi', $fileStatus, $fileReason, $applicationStatus, $id);
        $stmt->execute();

                if ($stmt->affected_rows === 1) {
            $message = $action === 'approve'
                ? 'Application has been successfully approved.'
                : 'Application rejected successfully.';
            $messageType = $action === 'approve' ? 'success' : 'error';
        } else {
            $message = 'This application is no longer awaiting your decision.';
            $messageType = 'error';
        }
        $stmt->close();
    } elseif ($action === 'reject') {
        $message = 'A rejection reason is required.';
        $messageType = 'error';
    }
}

$search = isset($_GET['search']) ? trim($_GET['search']) : '';
$sql = "SELECT a.id, a.application_no, a.nic, a.computer_no, a.boss_status,
               u.name, u.applicant_designation, u.applicant_current_work_station,
               u.applicant_personal_file_office
        FROM applications AS a
        INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.nic = a.nic
        WHERE a.boss_status = 'approved'
          AND a.file_status = 'pending'
          AND a.is_resubmission = 0
          AND a.application_status = 'pending_clerk'";

if ($search !== '') {
    $sql .= " AND (a.application_no LIKE ? OR a.nic LIKE ? OR a.computer_no LIKE ? OR u.name LIKE ?)";
    $searchTerm = '%' . $search . '%';
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
    $stmt->bind_param('ssss', $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm);
} else {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
}
$stmt->execute();
$filteredApps = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

$pageTitle = "Application Approval List - Sri Lanka Railways";
require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';

        function openRejectModal(appId) {
            document.getElementById('rejectAppId').value = appId;
            document.getElementById('rejectionReasonInput').value = '';
            document.getElementById('rejectModal').style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function closeModal(modalId) {
            document.getElementById(modalId).style.display = 'none';
        }

        // Auto remove message alert box after 2 seconds with fade-out effect
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
            const alertBox = document.getElementById('systemAlert');
            if (alertBox) {
                setTimeout(function() {
                    alertBox.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        alertBox.style.display = 'none';
                    }, 500); // Wait for fade-out transition to finish (0.5s)
                }, 2000); // 2 seconds delay
            }
        });
    </script>

<?php
/**
 * Application Approval List - Subject Clerk - Sri Lanka Railways
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Application Approval List - Sri Lanka Railways";

$userData = [
    'name' => 'Subject Clerk',
    'role' => 'Sri Lanka Railways - AOT',
    'initials' => 'SC'
];

$user = [
    'name' => $userData['name']
];

// Initialize mock session data if not already set[cite: 4]
if (!isset($_SESSION['applications'])) {
    $_SESSION['applications'] = [
        ['id' => 1, 'appNo' => 'SLR/AOT/2026/0001', 'nic' => '981234567V', 'compNo' => '1054', 'name' => 'A. B. Perera', 'desig' => 'Station Master'],
        ['id' => 2, 'appNo' => 'SLR/AOT/2026/0002', 'nic' => '957891234V', 'compNo' => '1055', 'name' => 'K. D. Silva', 'desig' => 'Signal Inspector'],
        ['id' => 3, 'appNo' => 'SLR/AOT/2026/0003', 'nic' => '923456789V', 'compNo' => '1056', 'name' => 'M. N. Fernando', 'desig' => 'Locomotive Driver']
    ];
}

if (!isset($_SESSION['approvedApplications'])) {
    $_SESSION['approvedApplications'] = [];
}
if (!isset($_SESSION['rejectedApplications'])) {
    $_SESSION['rejectedApplications'] = [];
}

$alert_msg = '';
$alert_type = '';

// Handle Form Actions (Approve or Reject)[cite: 4]
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $action = $_POST['action'] ?? '';
    $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

    if ($action === 'approve') {
        foreach ($_SESSION['applications'] as $index => $item) {
            if ($item['id'] === $id) {
                $_SESSION['approvedApplications'][] = $item;
                unset($_SESSION['applications'][$index]);
                $_SESSION['applications'] = array_values($_SESSION['applications']);
                $alert_msg = "Application approved successfully and moved to Approved List.";
                $alert_type = "success";
                break;
            }
        }
    } elseif ($action === 'reject') {
        $reason = trim($_POST['rejectionReason'] ?? '');
        if (!empty($reason)) {
            foreach ($_SESSION['applications'] as $index => $item) {
                if ($item['id'] === $id) {
                    $item['rejectionReason'] = $reason;
                    $_SESSION['rejectedApplications'][] = $item;
                    unset($_SESSION['applications'][$index]);
                    $_SESSION['applications'] = array_values($_SESSION['applications']);
                    $alert_msg = "Application rejected and moved to Rejected List.";
                    $alert_type = "error";
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Handle Search Filter[cite: 4]
$searchQuery = trim($_GET['search'] ?? '');
$displayData = $_SESSION['applications'];

if (!empty($searchQuery)) {
    $displayData = array_filter($displayData, function($item) use ($searchQuery) {
        return stripos($item['nic'], $searchQuery) !== false || stripos($item['name'], $searchQuery) !== false;
    });
}

<script>
    function promptReject(id) {
        document.getElementById('rejectRowId').value = id;
        document.getElementById('rejectionReasonInput').value = '';
        document.getElementById('rejectModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeRejectModal() {
        document.getElementById('rejectModal').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('rejectRowId').value = '';
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const alertBox = document.getElementById('systemAlert');
        if (alertBox) {
            setTimeout(function() {
                alertBox.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(function() {
                    alertBox.style.display = 'none';
                }, 500);
            }, 2000);
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<?php
/**
 * Application Approval List - Sri Lanka Railways
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Application Approval List - Sri Lanka Railways";

$userData = [
    'name' => $_SESSION['user_name'] ?? 'Immediate Boss',
    'role' => 'Sri Lanka Railways - AOT',
    'initials' => 'IB'
];

$user = [
    'name' => $userData['name']
];

$alert_msg = '';
$alert_type = '';
$conn = getDBConnection();

// Save the Immediate Boss decision on the application record.
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $action = $_POST['action'] ?? '';
    $id = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
    $reason = trim((string)($_POST['rejectionReason'] ?? ''));

    if ($id && ($action === 'approve' || ($action === 'reject' && $reason !== ''))) {
        $bossStatus = $action === 'approve' ? 'approved' : 'rejected';
        $bossReason = $action === 'reject' ? $reason : null;
           $applicationStatus = $action === 'approve' ? 'pending_clerk' : 'rejected';
        $stmt = $conn->prepare(
            "UPDATE applications
               SET boss_status = ?, boss_reason = ?, application_status = ?
               WHERE id = ? AND boss_status = 'pending' AND application_status = 'submitted'
               AND is_resubmission = 0"
        );
           $stmt->bind_param('sssi', $bossStatus, $bossReason, $applicationStatus, $id);
        $stmt->execute();

            if ($stmt->affected_rows === 1) {
            $alert_msg = $action === 'approve'
                ? 'Application approved successfully.'
                : 'Application rejected successfully.';
            $alert_type = $action === 'approve' ? 'success' : 'error';

            // Notify the applicant when rejected
            if ($action === 'reject') {
                $notifStmt = $conn->prepare(
                    "INSERT INTO notifications (nic, title, message, is_read)
                     SELECT nic, 'Application Rejected',
                            CONCAT('Your application was rejected by the Immediate Boss. Reason: ', ?),
                            0
                     FROM applications WHERE id = ?"
                );
                $notifStmt->bind_param('si', $reason, $id);
                $notifStmt->execute();
                $notifStmt->close();
            }
        } else {
            $alert_msg = 'This application is no longer awaiting your decision.';
            $alert_type = 'error';
        }
        $stmt->close();
    } elseif ($action === 'reject') {
        $alert_msg = 'A rejection reason is required.';
        $alert_type = 'error';
    }
}

// Fetch the current Immediate Boss queue and applicant details.
$searchQuery = trim($_GET['search'] ?? '');
$sql = "SELECT a.id, a.application_no, a.nic, a.computer_no, a.application_date,
               u.name, u.applicant_designation
        FROM applications AS a
        INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.nic = a.nic
        WHERE a.boss_status = 'pending'
                    AND a.application_status = 'submitted'
          AND a.is_resubmission = 0";

if ($searchQuery !== '') {
    $sql .= " AND (a.application_no LIKE ? OR a.nic LIKE ? OR a.computer_no LIKE ? OR u.name LIKE ?)";
    $searchTerm = '%' . $searchQuery . '%';
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
    $stmt->bind_param('ssss', $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm);
} else {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
}
$stmt->execute();
$displayData = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

// PHP filtering function[cite: 6, 7]
function filterData($data, $status, $query) {
    return array_filter($data, function($item) use ($status, $query) {
        if ($item['status'] !== $status) return false;
        if ($query !== '') {
            $q = strtolower($query);
            return strpos(strtolower($item['nic']), $q) !== false || strpos(strtolower($item['name']), $q) !== false;
        }
        return true;
    });
}

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<?php
/**
 * Approved & Rejected Applications Log - Sri Lanka Railways
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Approved & Rejected Applications Log - Sri Lanka Railways";

$activeTab = ($_GET['tab'] ?? 'approved') === 'rejected' ? 'rejected' : 'approved';
$searchQuery = trim($_GET['search'] ?? '');
$approvedList = [];
$rejectedList = [];
$conn = getDBConnection();
$sql = "SELECT a.id, a.application_no, a.nic, a.computer_no, a.boss_status,
               a.boss_reason, u.name, u.applicant_designation
        FROM applications AS a
        INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.nic = a.nic
        WHERE a.boss_status IN ('approved', 'rejected')";

if ($searchQuery !== '') {
    $sql .= " AND (a.application_no LIKE ? OR a.nic LIKE ? OR a.computer_no LIKE ? OR u.name LIKE ?)";
    $searchTerm = '%' . $searchQuery . '%';
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date DESC, a.id DESC');
    $stmt->bind_param('ssss', $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm);
} else {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date DESC, a.id DESC');
}
$stmt->execute();
$logData = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

foreach ($logData as $item) {
    $item['reason'] = $item['boss_reason'] ?: '-';
    if ($item['boss_status'] === 'approved') {
        $approvedList[] = $item;
    } else {
        $rejectedList[] = $item;
    }
}

<?php
/**
 * Approved & Rejected Applications Log - Sri Lanka Railways (PF)
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// Page Title
$pageTitle = "Approved & Rejected Applications Log - Sri Lanka Railways";

$activeTab = ($_GET['tab'] ?? 'approved') === 'rejected' ? 'rejected' : 'approved';
$searchQuery = trim($_GET['search'] ?? '');
$approvedList = [];
$rejectedList = [];
$conn = getDBConnection();
$sql = "SELECT a.id, a.application_no, a.nic, a.computer_no, a.file_status,
               a.file_reason, u.name, u.applicant_designation
        FROM applications AS a
        INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.nic = a.nic
        WHERE a.file_status IN ('approved', 'rejected')";

if ($searchQuery !== '') {
    $sql .= " AND (a.application_no LIKE ? OR a.nic LIKE ? OR a.computer_no LIKE ? OR u.name LIKE ?)";
    $searchTerm = '%' . $searchQuery . '%';
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date DESC, a.id DESC');
    $stmt->bind_param('ssss', $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm);
} else {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date DESC, a.id DESC');
}
$stmt->execute();
$logData = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

foreach ($logData as $item) {
    $item['reason'] = $item['file_reason'] ?: '-';
    if ($item['file_status'] === 'approved') {
        $approvedList[] = $item;
    } else {
        $rejectedList[] = $item;
    }
}

// Include Admin Header
require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<?php
/**
 * Delete Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways Admin
 * Handles the delete button from quarters_list.php
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$id = filter_input(INPUT_GET, 'id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
if (!$id) {
    header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/quarters_list.php'));
    exit;
}

$conn = getDBConnection();
$stmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM quarters WHERE id = ?");
$stmt->bind_param("i", $id);
$stmt->execute();
$deleted = $stmt->affected_rows;
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/quarters_list.php?deleted=' . ($deleted ? '1' : '0')));
exit;

<script>
    const serverAllocationsData = <?php echo json_encode($allocationsData); ?>;
    const searchQuery = "<?php echo htmlspecialchars($searchQuery, ENT_QUOTES); ?>".toLowerCase();

    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }

    function getStoredAllocations() {
        const data = localStorage.getItem('directAllocations');
        if (!data) {
            localStorage.setItem('directAllocations', JSON.stringify(serverAllocationsData));
            return serverAllocationsData;
        }
        return JSON.parse(data);
    }

    function loadTableData() {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('tableBody');
        tbody.innerHTML = '';

        let data = getStoredAllocations();

        if (searchQuery !== '') {
            data = data.filter(item => 
                (item.nic && item.nic.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) ||
                (item.computerNo && item.computerNo.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) ||
                (item.fullName && item.fullName.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery))
            );
        }

        if (data.length === 0) {
            tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="12" style="text-align: center; color: #64748b; padding: 25px;">No direct allocations found.</td></tr>`;
            return;
        }

        data.forEach((item, index) => {
            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.innerHTML = `
                <td>${index + 1}</td>
                <td>${item.nic || '-'}</td>
                <td>${item.computerNo || '-'}</td>
                <td>${item.fullName || '-'}</td>
                <td>${item.quarterNo || '-'}</td>
                <td>${item.quarterName || '-'}</td>
                <td>${item.quarterLocation || '-'}</td>
                <td>${item.quarterType || '-'}</td>
                <td>${item.phone || '-'}</td>
                <td>${item.reason || '-'}</td>
                <td>
                    <a href="language_dashboard.php" class="btn-app" title="Go to Application"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square"></i> Go to App</a>
                </td>
                <td>
                    <div class="action-cell">
                        <a href="view_direct_allocation_FA.php?id=${index}" class="action-btn btn-view" title="View Details"><i class="fa-solid fa-eye"></i></a>
                        <a href="edit_direct_allocation_FA.php?id=${index}" class="action-btn btn-edit" title="Edit"><i class="fa-solid fa-pen"></i></a>
                        <button type="button" class="action-btn btn-delete" onclick="promptDelete(${index})" title="Delete"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i></button>
                    </div>
                </td>
            `;
            tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        loadTableData();
    });

    let deleteTargetIndex = null;
    function promptDelete(index) {
        deleteTargetIndex = index;
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeDeleteModal() {
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').style.display = 'none';
        deleteTargetIndex = null;
    }

    document.getElementById('confirmDeleteBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (deleteTargetIndex !== null) {
            let allocations = getStoredAllocations();
            allocations.splice(deleteTargetIndex, 1);
            localStorage.setItem('directAllocations', JSON.stringify(allocations));
            loadTableData();
            closeDeleteModal();
        }
    });
</script>

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_footer.php';
?>
