<?php
/**
 * Edit Allocated Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways Admin
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Edit Allocated Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways";

// Database configuration
$host = 'localhost';
$dbname = 'admin_dashboard_db';
$username = 'root';
$password = '';

try {
    $pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=$host;dbname=$dbname;charset=utf8mb4", $username, $password);
    $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    die("Connection failed: " . $e->getMessage());
}

$id = isset($_GET['id']) ? intval($_GET['id']) : 0;
$errorMessage = '';

// Form submit zalyavar data update karnyasathi
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $nic = $_POST['nic'] ?? '';
    $computerNo = $_POST['computerNo'] ?? '';
    $quarterNo = $_POST['quarterNo'] ?? '';
    $quarterName = $_POST['quarterName'] ?? '';
    $quarterLocation = $_POST['quarterLocation'] ?? '';
    $quarterType = $_POST['quarterType'] ?? '';
    $residentName = $_POST['residentName'] ?? '';
    $designation = $_POST['designation'] ?? '';
    $workplace = $_POST['workplace'] ?? '';
    $allocatedDate = $_POST['allocatedDate'] ?? '';
    $other = $_POST['other'] ?? 'None';

    try {
        $stmt = $pdo->prepare("UPDATE allocated_quarters SET nic = ?, computer_no = ?, quarter_no = ?, quarter_name = ?, quarter_location = ?, quarter_type = ?, resident_name = ?, designation = ?, workplace = ?, allocated_date = ?, other = ? WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$nic, $computerNo, $quarterNo, $quarterName, $quarterLocation, $quarterType, $residentName, $designation, $workplace, $allocatedDate, $other, $id]);
        
        header("Location: allocated_quarters.php");
        exit();
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $errorMessage = "Error updating record: " . $e->getMessage();
    }
}

// Existing record fetch karne
$stmt = $pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM allocated_quarters WHERE id = ?");
$stmt->execute([$id]);
$record = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

if (!$record) {
    echo "<script>alert('Record not found!'); window.location.href='allocated_quarters.php';</script>";
    exit();
}

    function getStoredAllocations() {
        const data = localStorage.getItem('directAllocations');
        if (!data) {
            localStorage.setItem('directAllocations', JSON.stringify(serverAllocationsData));
            return serverAllocationsData;
        }
        return JSON.parse(data);
    }

    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }

    let editIndex = null;

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        editIndex = urlParams.get('id');

        const allocations = getStoredAllocations();
        if (editIndex !== null && allocations[editIndex]) {
            const item = allocations[editIndex];
            document.getElementById('nic').value = item.nic || '';
            document.getElementById('computerNo').value = item.computerNo || '';
            document.getElementById('fullName').value = item.fullName || '';
            document.getElementById('phone').value = item.phone || '';
            document.getElementById('quarterNo').value = item.quarterNo || '';
            document.getElementById('quarterName').value = item.quarterName || '';
            document.getElementById('quarterLocation').value = item.quarterLocation || '';
            document.getElementById('quarterType').value = item.quarterType || '';
            document.getElementById('reason').value = item.reason || '';
        }
    });

    document.getElementById('editDirectAllocationForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();

        let allocations = getStoredAllocations();
        if (editIndex !== null && allocations[editIndex]) {
            allocations[editIndex] = {
                nic: document.getElementById('nic').value,
                computerNo: document.getElementById('computerNo').value,
                fullName: document.getElementById('fullName').value,
                phone: document.getElementById('phone').value,
                quarterNo: document.getElementById('quarterNo').value,
                quarterName: document.getElementById('quarterName').value,
                quarterLocation: document.getElementById('quarterLocation').value,
                quarterType: document.getElementById('quarterType').value,
                reason: document.getElementById('reason').value
            };

            localStorage.setItem('directAllocations', JSON.stringify(allocations));

            const alertBox = document.getElementById('successAlert');
            alertBox.style.display = 'block';

            setTimeout(() => {
                window.location.href = "direct_allocation_FA.php";
            }, 1500);
        }
    });

<?php
/**
 * Edit Maintenance Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways (database-backed)
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Edit Maintenance Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways Admin";

$userData = [
    'name' => 'Subject Clerk',
    'role' => 'Sri Lanka Railways - AOT',
    'initials' => 'SC'
];

$error = '';
$id = filter_input(INPUT_GET, 'id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
if (!$id) {
    header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/maintenance.php'));
    exit;
}

$conn = getDBConnection();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $quarter_number        = trim($_POST['quarter_number'] ?? '');
    $quarter_name          = trim($_POST['quarter_name'] ?? '');
    $location_name         = trim($_POST['location_name'] ?? '');
    $quarter_type          = trim($_POST['quarter_type'] ?? '');
    $maintenance_status    = trim($_POST['maintenance_status'] ?? 'Under Maintenance');
    $last_maintenance_date = ($_POST['last_maintenance_date'] ?? '') ?: null;
    $notes                 = trim($_POST['notes'] ?? '') ?: null;

    if ($quarter_number === '' || $location_name === '' || $quarter_type === '') {
        $error = 'Quarter No, Location and Quarter Type are required.';
    } else {
        $stmt = $conn->prepare(
            "UPDATE maintenance
                SET quarter_number = ?, quarter_name = ?, location_name = ?, quarter_type = ?,
                    maintenance_status = ?, last_maintenance_date = ?, notes = ?
              WHERE id = ?"
        );
        $stmt->bind_param(
            "sssssssi",
            $quarter_number, $quarter_name, $location_name, $quarter_type,
            $maintenance_status, $last_maintenance_date, $notes, $id
        );
        if ($stmt->execute()) {
            $stmt->close();
            $conn->close();
            header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/maintenance.php'));
            exit;
        }
        $error = 'Update failed: ' . $conn->error;
        $stmt->close();
    }
}

$stmt = $conn->prepare(
    "SELECT id, quarter_number, quarter_name, location_name, quarter_type,
            maintenance_status, last_maintenance_date, notes
       FROM maintenance WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1"
);
$stmt->bind_param("i", $id);
$stmt->execute();
$row = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

if (!$row) {
    header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/maintenance.php'));
    exit;
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';

<?php
/**
 * Edit Profile Page - Sri Lanka Railways Quarter Management System
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// දත්ත සමුදාය සම්බන්ධතාවය
$host = 'localhost';
$username = 'root';
$password = '';
$database = 'admin_dashboard_db'; // අවශ්‍ය නම් ඔබේ database නම මෙහි වෙනස් කරන්න

$conn = new mysqli($host, $username, $password, $database);

if ($conn->connect_error) {
    die("දත්ත සමුදාය සම්බන්ධ වීම අසාර්ථක විය: " . $conn->connect_error);
}

$success_message = '';
$error_message = '';

// පද්ධතියේ ලොග් වන පරිශීලකයාගේ ID එක සැසියෙන් (Session) නිවැරදිව ලබා ගැනීම
$logged_in_id = $_SESSION['user_id'] 
             ?? $_SESSION['admin_id'] 
             ?? $_SESSION['boss_id'] 
             ?? $_SESSION['clerk_id'] 
             ?? $_SESSION['officer_id'] 
             ?? $_SESSION['id'] ?? 0;

// NIC මඟින් ලොග වී ඇත්නම් ID එක ලබා ගැනීමට ආරක්ෂිත පියවරක්
if ($logged_in_id <= 0 && isset($_SESSION['nic'])) {
    $nic_session = $_SESSION['nic'];
    $id_stmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT id FROM users WHERE nic = ?");
    $id_stmt->bind_param("s", $nic_session);
    $id_stmt->execute();
    $id_res = $id_stmt->get_result();
    if ($row = $id_res->fetch_assoc()) {
        $logged_in_id = $row['id'];
        $_SESSION['user_id'] = $logged_in_id;
    }
    $id_stmt->close();
}

if ($logged_in_id <= 0) {
    if (isset($_SESSION['admin_name']) || isset($_SESSION['name'])) {
        $logged_in_id = 1; 
    } else {
        header("Location: " . baseUrl('index.php')); 
        exit();
    }
}

// පෝරමය සබ්මිට් වූ විට දත්ත යාවත්කාලීන කිරීම
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $email = trim($_POST['email'] ?? '');
    $computer_number = trim($_POST['computer_number'] ?? '');
    $mobile = trim($_POST['mobile'] ?? '');
    $whatsapp = trim($_POST['whatsapp'] ?? '');
    $current_password = $_POST['current_password'] ?? '';
    $new_password = $_POST['new_password'] ?? '';
    $confirm_password = $_POST['confirm_password'] ?? '';

    if (empty($email) || empty($mobile)) {
        $error_message = "ඊමේල් ලිපිනය සහ ජංගම දුරකථන අංකය ඇතුළත් කිරීම අත්‍යවශ්‍ය වේ.";
    } else {
        // දත්ත සමුදායේ ප්‍රොෆයිල් දත්ත යාවත්කාලීන කිරීම
        $update_stmt = $conn->prepare("UPDATE users SET email = ?, computer_number = ?, mobile = ?, whatsapp = ? WHERE id = ?");
        $update_stmt->bind_param("ssssi", $email, $computer_number, $mobile, $whatsapp, $logged_in_id);
        
        if ($update_stmt->execute()) {
            $success_message = "ප්‍රොෆයිල් දත්ත සාර්ථකව යාවත්කාලීන කරන ලදී!";
        } else {
            $error_message = "දත්ත යාවත්කාලීන කිරීමේ දෝෂයක් සිදු විය.";
        }
        $update_stmt->close();

        // මුරපදය වෙනස් කිරීම පරීක්ෂා කිරීම
        if (!empty($new_password) || !empty($confirm_password)) {
            if ($new_password !== $confirm_password) {
                $error_message = "නව මුරපද එකිනෙකට නොගැලපේ.";
            } else {
                $hashed_password = password_hash($new_password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
                $pass_stmt = $conn->prepare("UPDATE users SET password = ? WHERE id = ?");
                $pass_stmt->bind_param("si", $hashed_password, $logged_in_id);
                $pass_stmt->execute();
                $pass_stmt->close();

                $success_message = "ප්‍රොෆයිලය සහ මුරපදය සාර්ථකව යාවත්කාලීන කරන ලදී!";
            }
        }
    }
}

// දත්ත සමුදායෙන් ලොග් වී සිටින අදාළ පරිශීලකයා ලියාපදිංචි වන විට ලබාදුන් දත්ත ලබා ගැනීම (Auto-fill සඳහා)

<?php
/**
 * Edit Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways Admin
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Edit Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways Admin";

$userData = [
    'name' => 'Subject Clerk',
    'role' => 'Sri Lanka Railways - AOT',
    'initials' => 'SC'
];

$error = '';

$id = filter_input(INPUT_GET, 'id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
if (!$id) {
    header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/quarters_list.php'));
    exit;
}

$conn = getDBConnection();

// Handle update
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $quarter_number          = trim($_POST['quarter_number']          ?? '');
    $quarter_name            = trim($_POST['quarter_name']            ?? '');
    $location_name           = trim($_POST['location_name']           ?? '');
    $quarter_address         = trim($_POST['quarter_address']         ?? '');
    $quarter_type            = trim($_POST['quarter_type']            ?? '');
    $quarter_division        = trim($_POST['quarter_division']        ?? '');
    $quarter_ownership       = trim($_POST['quarter_ownership']       ?? '');
    $quarter_area            = trim($_POST['quarter_area']            ?? '');
    $quarter_assessment_rent = (float)($_POST['quarter_assessment_rent'] ?? 0);
    $quarter_status          = $_POST['quarter_status']               ?? 'Available';
    $has_electricity         = isset($_POST['has_electricity']) ? 1 : 0;
    $has_water               = isset($_POST['has_water'])       ? 1 : 0;

    if ($quarter_number === '' || $location_name === '' || $quarter_type === '') {
        $error = 'Quarter No., Location, and Quarter Type are required.';
    } elseif (!in_array($quarter_status, ['Available', 'Occupied', 'Under Maintenance'], true)) {
        $error = 'Please select a valid quarter status.';
    } else {
        $stmt = $conn->prepare(
            "UPDATE quarters SET
                quarter_number = ?, quarter_name = ?, location_name = ?, quarter_address = ?,
                quarter_type = ?, quarter_division = ?, quarter_ownership = ?, quarter_area = ?,
                quarter_assessment_rent = ?, quarter_status = ?,
                has_electricity = ?, has_water = ?
              WHERE id = ?"
        );
        $stmt->bind_param(
            "ssssssssdsiii",
            $quarter_number,
            $quarter_name,
            $location_name,
            $quarter_address,
            $quarter_type,
            $quarter_division,
            $quarter_ownership,
            $quarter_area,
            $quarter_assessment_rent,
            $quarter_status,
            $has_electricity,
            $has_water,
            $id
        );

        if ($stmt->execute()) {
            $stmt->close();
            $conn->close();
            header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/quarters_list.php'));
            exit;
        }
        $error = 'Update failed: ' . $conn->error;
        $stmt->close();
    }
}

// Fetch row
$stmt = $conn->prepare(
    "SELECT id, quarter_number, quarter_name, location_name, quarter_address,
            quarter_type, quarter_division, quarter_ownership, quarter_area,
            quarter_assessment_rent, is_active, quarter_status,
            has_electricity, has_water, sort_order
       FROM quarters WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1"
);
$stmt->bind_param("i", $id);
$stmt->execute();
$row = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

if (!$row) {
    header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/quarters_list.php'));
    exit;
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<?php
/**
 * Edit System User - Sri Lanka Railways
 * Reads and updates a staff user from the real `users` table.
 */
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

$pageTitle = "Edit System User - Sri Lanka Railways";
$hide_admin_extras = true;

$error_message = '';
$nic = $_GET['nic'] ?? '';

$roles = [
    2 => 'Super Admin',
    3 => 'Immediate Boss',
    4 => 'Personal File',
    5 => 'Subject Clerk',
    6 => 'Branch Officer',
    7 => 'Final Approval',
];

$conn = getDBConnection();

// Fetch staff user
$user_row = null;
if ($nic !== '') {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare(
        "SELECT nic, name, email, computer_number, mobile, role_id
           FROM users
          WHERE nic = ? AND role_id BETWEEN 2 AND 7
          LIMIT 1"
    );
    $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
    $stmt->execute();
    $user_row = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
    $stmt->close();
}

if (!$user_row) {
    $_SESSION['flash_message'] = 'System user not found.';
    $conn->close();
    header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/system-users.php'));
    exit;
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $newNic      = trim($_POST['nic'] ?? '');
    $computer_no = trim($_POST['computer_no'] ?? '');
    $name        = trim($_POST['full_name'] ?? '');
    $email       = trim($_POST['email'] ?? '');
    $phone       = trim($_POST['phone'] ?? '');
    $role_id     = (int) ($_POST['role_id'] ?? 0);
    $password    = $_POST['password'] ?? '';
    $confirm     = $_POST['confirm_password'] ?? '';

    if (!array_key_exists($role_id, $roles)) {
        $error_message = 'Please select a valid staff role.';
    } elseif (!empty($password) && $password !== $confirm) {
        $error_message = 'Passwords do not match! Please check again.';
    } else {
        if (!empty($password)) {
            $hash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12]);
            $upd = $conn->prepare(
                "UPDATE users
                    SET nic = ?, computer_number = ?, name = ?, email = ?, mobile = ?, role_id = ?, password = ?
                  WHERE nic = ? AND role_id BETWEEN 2 AND 7"
            );
            $upd->bind_param("sssssiss", $newNic, $computer_no, $name, $email, $phone, $role_id, $hash, $nic);
        } else {
            $upd = $conn->prepare(
                "UPDATE users
                    SET nic = ?, computer_number = ?, name = ?, email = ?, mobile = ?, role_id = ?
                  WHERE nic = ? AND role_id BETWEEN 2 AND 7"
            );
            $upd->bind_param("sssssis", $newNic, $computer_no, $name, $email, $phone, $role_id, $nic);
        }

        if ($upd->execute()) {
            $upd->close();
            $conn->close();
            $_SESSION['flash_message'] = 'System user updated successfully!';
            header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/system-users.php'));
            exit;
        } else {
            $error_message = 'Update failed: ' . $conn->error;
            $upd->close();
        }
    }
}

$conn->close();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

<?php
/**
 * Edit User Details - Sri Lanka Railways
 * Fetches and updates applicant records directly from the `users` table.
 */
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

$pageTitle = "Edit User Details - Sri Lanka Railways";
$error_message = '';
$nic = $_GET['nic'] ?? '';

$conn = getDBConnection();

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. Fetch the existing user row from the database
// ------------------------------------------------------------
$user_row = null;
if ($nic !== '') {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare(
        "SELECT nic, name, email, computer_number, mobile, created_at
           FROM users
          WHERE nic = ? AND role_id = 1
          LIMIT 1"
    );
    $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
    $stmt->execute();
    $user_row = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
    $stmt->close();
}

if (!$user_row) {
    $_SESSION['flash_message'] = 'User not found.';
    $conn->close();
    header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/view_users.php'));
    exit;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. Handle form submission (UPDATE the real database row)
// ------------------------------------------------------------
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $newNic       = trim($_POST['nic'] ?? '');
    $computer_no  = trim($_POST['computer_no'] ?? '');
    $name         = trim($_POST['name'] ?? '');
    $email        = trim($_POST['email'] ?? '');
    $mobile       = trim($_POST['mobile'] ?? '');
    $password     = $_POST['password'] ?? '';
    $confirm_pass = $_POST['confirm_password'] ?? '';

    if (!empty($password) && $password !== $confirm_pass) {
        $error_message = "Passwords do not match! Please check again.";
    } else {
        try {
            if (!empty($password)) {
                $hash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
                $upd = $conn->prepare(
                    "UPDATE users
                        SET nic = ?, computer_number = ?, name = ?, email = ?, mobile = ?, password = ?
                      WHERE nic = ?"
                );
                $upd->bind_param("sssssss", $newNic, $computer_no, $name, $email, $mobile, $hash, $nic);
            } else {
                $upd = $conn->prepare(
                    "UPDATE users
                        SET nic = ?, computer_number = ?, name = ?, email = ?, mobile = ?
                      WHERE nic = ?"
                );
                $upd->bind_param("ssssss", $newNic, $computer_no, $name, $email, $mobile, $nic);
            }

            if ($upd->execute()) {
                $upd->close();
                $conn->close();

                $_SESSION['flash_message'] = "User record updated successfully!";
                header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/view_users.php'));
                exit;
            } else {
                $error_message = "Update failed: " . htmlspecialchars($conn->error);
                $upd->close();
            }
        } catch (mysqli_sql_exception $e) {
            // Usually caused by changing NIC to one that already exists (duplicate key)
            $error_message = "Update failed: " . htmlspecialchars($e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}

$conn->close();

// Hide the admin dashboard title and profile dropdown on this inner page
$hide_admin_extras = true;

// Include Admin Header layout
require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }

    const applicantsDatabase = {
        "SLR/AOT/2026/0001": {
            nic: "883421092V",
            fullName: "A. B. Perera",
            designation: "Station Master",
            receiverAddress: "Railway Station, Polgahawela",
            quarterType: "Q-01",
            quarterName: "Sunflower Manor"
        },
        "SLR/AOT/2026/0002": {
            nic: "925631485V",
            fullName: "S. K. Silva",
            designation: "Signal Inspector",
            receiverAddress: "Railway Signal Office, Colombo Fort",
            quarterType: "Q-02",
            quarterName: "Railway Bungalow 02"
        },
        "SLR/AOT/2026/0003": {
            nic: "951234789V",
            fullName: "M. N. Fernando",
            designation: "Loco Driver",
            receiverAddress: "Railway Shed, Anuradhapura",
            quarterType: "Q-03",
            quarterName: "Staff Flat 04"
        }
    };

    function autoFillApplicant(appNoValue) {
        const rawVal = appNoValue.trim();
        const trimmedKey = rawVal.toUpperCase().startsWith("SLR/AOT/") ? rawVal.toUpperCase() : "SLR/AOT/2026/" + rawVal;
        const matchedData = applicantsDatabase[trimmedKey];

        if (matchedData) {
            document.getElementById('nic').value = matchedData.nic;
            document.getElementById('fullName').value = matchedData.fullName;
            document.getElementById('designation').value = matchedData.designation;
            document.getElementById('receiverAddress').value = matchedData.receiverAddress;
            document.getElementById('quarterType').value = matchedData.quarterType;
            document.getElementById('quarterName').value = matchedData.quarterName;
            
            document.getElementById('letterSubject').value = "Request for Quarter Allocation for " + matchedData.fullName + " (" + matchedData.designation + ")";
        } else {
            document.getElementById('nic').value = '';
            document.getElementById('fullName').value = '';
            document.getElementById('designation').value = '';
            document.getElementById('receiverAddress').value = '';
            document.getElementById('quarterType').value = '';
            document.getElementById('quarterName').value = '';
        }
    }

    function generateLetter(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        updatePreviewContent();

        document.getElementById('letterPreviewBox').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('letterActionsBar').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('letterPreviewBox').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    function updatePreviewContent() {
        let appInput = document.getElementById('appNo').value.trim();
        let appNoClean = appInput.replace(/^SLR\/AOT\/2026\//i, '');
        if(!appNoClean) appNoClean = '0001';

        const nic = document.getElementById('nic').value || '---';
        const fullName = document.getElementById('fullName').value || '---';
        const designation = document.getElementById('designation').value || '---';
        const receiverAddress = document.getElementById('receiverAddress').value || '---';
        const quarterType = document.getElementById('quarterType').value || '---';
        const quarterName = document.getElementById('quarterName').value || '---';
        const letterSubject = document.getElementById('letterSubject').value || '---';
        const mainDescription = document.getElementById('mainDescription').value || '';

        document.getElementById('pSubjectTitle').innerText = letterSubject;

        const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        document.getElementById('pDate').innerText = today;

        document.getElementById('pIntroPara').innerHTML = `This letter is submitted regarding the quarter allocation request made by <strong>${fullName}</strong> (Designation: <strong>${designation}</strong>, NIC: <strong>${nic}</strong>, Workplace: <strong>${receiverAddress}</strong>) under Application Reference No: <strong>SLR/AOT/2026/${appNoClean}</strong> for Quarter No: <strong>${quarterType}</strong> (${quarterName}).`;
        
        document.getElementById('pCustomDescPara').innerHTML = mainDescription;
    }

    function triggerPrint() {
        updatePreviewContent();
        document.getElementById('letterPreviewBox').style.display = 'block';
        window.print();
    }
</script>

<?php
/**
 * Immediate Boss Dashboard - Sri Lanka Railways
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// pituwe naama (Page Title) sækasima
$pageTitle = "Immediate Boss Dashboard - Sri Lanka Railways";

// Calculate real dashboard stats from the database
$conn = getDBConnection();

// Total approval list = all applications that have reached or passed the IB stage
// (i.e. submitted applications that are in the boss workflow, or beyond it)
$totalStmt = $conn->query(
    "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
     FROM applications
     WHERE application_status IN ('submitted', 'pending_clerk', 'pending_super', 'approved', 'rejected')
       AND boss_status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')"
);
$totalApprovals = (int)($totalStmt->fetch_assoc()['total'] ?? 0);
$totalStmt->close();

// Pending list = applications currently waiting for the Immediate Boss decision
$pendingStmt = $conn->query(
    "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
     FROM applications
     WHERE boss_status = 'pending'
       AND application_status = 'submitted'"
);
$pendingCount = (int)($pendingStmt->fetch_assoc()['total'] ?? 0);
$pendingStmt->close();

// Approved list = applications the Immediate Boss has approved
$approvedStmt = $conn->query(
    "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
     FROM applications
     WHERE boss_status = 'approved'"
);
$approvedCount = (int)($approvedStmt->fetch_assoc()['total'] ?? 0);
$approvedStmt->close();

// Rejected list = applications the Immediate Boss has rejected
$rejectedStmt = $conn->query(
    "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
     FROM applications
     WHERE boss_status = 'rejected'"
);
$rejectedCount = (int)($rejectedStmt->fetch_assoc()['total'] ?? 0);
$rejectedStmt->close();

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<?php
/**
 * Quarters Maintenance - Sri Lanka Railways (database-backed)
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Quarters Maintenance - Sri Lanka Railways";

$userData = [
    'name' => 'Subject Clerk',
    'role' => 'Sri Lanka Railways - AOT',
    'initials' => 'SC'
];

$conn = getDBConnection();

// Handle delete
if (isset($_GET['delete']) && $_GET['delete'] !== '') {
    $deleteId = (int) $_GET['delete'];
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM maintenance WHERE id = ?");
    $stmt->bind_param("i", $deleteId);
    $stmt->execute();
    $stmt->close();
    $conn->close();
    header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/maintenance.php?msg=deleted'));
    exit;
}

// Fetch with search
$searchQuery = trim($_GET['search'] ?? '');
if ($searchQuery !== '') {
    $like = '%' . $searchQuery . '%';
    $stmt = $conn->prepare(
        "SELECT id, quarter_number, quarter_name, location_name, quarter_type,
                maintenance_status, last_maintenance_date, notes, created_at
           FROM maintenance
          WHERE quarter_number LIKE ? OR quarter_name LIKE ? OR location_name LIKE ?
          ORDER BY id DESC"
    );
    $stmt->bind_param("sss", $like, $like, $like);
} else {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare(
        "SELECT id, quarter_number, quarter_name, location_name, quarter_type,
                maintenance_status, last_maintenance_date, notes, created_at
           FROM maintenance
          ORDER BY id DESC"
    );
}
$stmt->execute();
$maintenanceData = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

$flash = (($_GET['msg'] ?? '') === 'deleted') ? 'Maintenance record deleted successfully.' : '';

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

];

];

$conn = getDBConnection();
$sql = "SELECT a.id, a.application_no, a.nic, a.computer_no, a.boss_status,
               u.name, u.applicant_designation
        FROM applications AS a
        INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.nic = a.nic
        WHERE a.boss_status = 'pending'
          AND a.application_status = 'submitted'
          AND a.is_resubmission = 0";

if ($searchVal !== '') {
    $sql .= " AND (a.application_no LIKE ? OR a.nic LIKE ? OR a.computer_no LIKE ? OR u.name LIKE ?)";
    $searchTerm = '%' . $searchVal . '%';
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
    $stmt->bind_param('ssss', $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm);
} else {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
}
$stmt->execute();
$pendingData = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<?php 
/**
 * Personal File Dashboard - Sri Lanka Railways
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// පිටුවේ නාමය (Page Title) සැකසීම
$pageTitle = "Personal File Dashboard - Sri Lanka Railways";

$conn = getDBConnection();
$statsResult = $conn->query(
    "SELECT file_status, COUNT(*) AS total
     FROM applications
     WHERE boss_status = 'approved'
       AND application_status IN ('pending_clerk', 'pending_super', 'approved', 'rejected')
       AND file_status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')
     GROUP BY file_status"
);
$dashboardStats = [
    'pending' => 0,
    'approved' => 0,
    'rejected' => 0
];
while ($stat = $statsResult->fetch_assoc()) {
    $dashboardStats[$stat['file_status']] = (int)$stat['total'];
}
$conn->close();

$pending_count = $dashboardStats['pending'];
$approved_count = $dashboardStats['approved'];
$rejected_count = $dashboardStats['rejected'];
$total_approvals = $pending_count + $approved_count + $rejected_count;

$user_name = isset($_SESSION['user_name']) ? $_SESSION['user_name'] : 'Personal File';
$user_role = isset($_SESSION['user_role']) ? trim($_SESSION['user_role']) : (isset($_SESSION['role']) ? trim($_SESSION['role']) : '');
$is_admin_session = isset($_SESSION['is_admin']) && ($_SESSION['is_admin'] === true || $_SESSION['is_admin'] == 1 || $_SESSION['is_admin'] == '1');
$user_initials = 'PF';

// stripos මඟින් 'admin' හෝ 'Admin' යන වචනය කුමන අයුරකින් තිබුණත් true ලෙස ගනී
$isAdmin = $is_admin_session || 
           (stripos($user_role, 'admin') !== false) || 
           (stripos($user_role, 'administrator') !== false);

// Admin Header එක ඇතුළත් කිරීම
require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

<script>
    const serverAllocatedData = <?php echo json_encode($allocatedData); ?>;

    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }

    function getStoredData() {
        const data = localStorage.getItem('allocatedQuartersData');
        const storedData = data ? JSON.parse(data) : [];

        const mergedData = [...serverAllocatedData];
        storedData.forEach(item => {
            const isDuplicate = mergedData.some(existing =>
                existing.nic === item.nic && existing.computerNo === item.computerNo
            );
            if (!isDuplicate) {
                mergedData.push(item);
            }
        });

        return mergedData;
    }

    function loadTableData() {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('allocatedBody');
        tbody.innerHTML = '';
        const data = getStoredData();

        if (data.length === 0) {
            tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="12" style="text-align: center; color: #64748b; padding: 25px;">No allocated quarters records found.</td></tr>`;
            return;
        }

        data.forEach((item, index) => {
            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.innerHTML = `
                <td>${index + 1}</td>
                <td>${item.nic}</td>
                <td>${item.computerNo}</td>
                <td>${item.quarterNo || '-'}</td>
                <td>${item.quarterName || '-'}</td>
                <td>${item.quarterLocation || '-'}</td>
                <td>${item.quarterType}</td>
                <td>${item.residentName}</td>
                <td>${item.designation}</td>
                <td>${item.workplace}</td>
                <td>${item.allocatedDate}</td>
                <td>${item.other || 'None'}</td>
            `;
            tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { 
        loadTableData(); 
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

 * Quarters List - Sri Lanka Railways Admin
 * DB-driven version
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Quarters List - Sri Lanka Railways Admin";

$userData = [
    'name' => 'Subject Clerk',
    'role' => 'Sri Lanka Railways - AOT',
    'initials' => 'SC'
];

// --- Fetch all quarters from DB (ordered by id) ---
$conn = getDBConnection();
$quarters = [];
$sql = "SELECT * FROM quarters ORDER BY id ASC";
$result = $conn->query($sql);
if ($result && $result->num_rows > 0) {
    while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
        $quarters[] = $row;
    }
}
$conn->close();

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }

    // Search filter (client-side only)
    function searchTable() {
        const input = document.getElementById("searchInput");
        const filter = input.value.toLowerCase().trim();
        const clearBtn = document.getElementById("searchClearBtn");

        if (filter !== "") {
            clearBtn.style.display = "block";
        } else {
            clearBtn.style.display = "none";
        }

        const table = document.getElementById("quartersTable");
        const tr = table.getElementsByTagName("tr");

        for (let i = 1; i < tr.length; i++) {
            const tdQuarterNo = tr[i].getElementsByTagName("td")[1];
            const tdQuarterName = tr[i].getElementsByTagName("td")[2];
            
            let rowMatched = false;
            
            if (tdQuarterNo || tdQuarterName) {
                const noText = tdQuarterNo ? (tdQuarterNo.textContent || tdQuarterNo.innerText).toLowerCase() : "";
                const nameText = tdQuarterName ? (tdQuarterName.textContent || tdQuarterName.innerText).toLowerCase() : "";
                
                if (filter === "" || noText.includes(filter) || nameText.includes(filter)) {
                    rowMatched = true;
                }
            }

            tr[i].style.display = rowMatched ? "" : "none";
        }
    }

    function clearSearch() {
        const input = document.getElementById("searchInput");
        input.value = "";
        const clearBtn = document.getElementById("searchClearBtn");
        if (clearBtn) {
            clearBtn.style.display = "none";
        }
        const table = document.getElementById("quartersTable");
        const tr = table.getElementsByTagName("tr");
        for (let i = 1; i < tr.length; i++) {
            tr[i].style.display = "";
        }
    }

    // Delete confirmation
    let deleteTargetId = null;
    function promptDelete(id) {
        deleteTargetId = id;
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeDeleteModal() {
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').style.display = 'none';
        deleteTargetId = null;
    }

    document.getElementById('confirmDeleteBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (deleteTargetId !== null) {
            // Redirect to delete handler (create delete_quarter.php to process deletion)
            window.location.href = 'delete_quarter.php?id=' + deleteTargetId;
        }
    });

    // Show toast if deletion success flag is set (e.g., via query param)
    (function() {
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if (urlParams.get('deleted') === '1') {
            const toast = document.getElementById('systemToast');
            toast.style.display = 'flex';
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.style.display = 'none';
            }, 2200);
            // Clean the URL so refresh doesn't re-show
            if (window.history.replaceState) {
                const newUrl = window.location.pathname;
                window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, newUrl);
            }
        }
    })();
</script>

<?php
/**
 * Application Approval List - Sri Lanka Railways
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Application Approval List - Sri Lanka Railways";

$userData = [
    'name' => 'Immediate Boss',
    'role' => 'Sri Lanka Railways - AOT',
    'initials' => 'IB'
];

$user = [
    'name' => $userData['name']
];

$alert_msg = '';
$alert_type = '';
$conn = getDBConnection();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $action = $_POST['action'] ?? '';
    $id = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
    $reason = trim((string)($_POST['rejectionReason'] ?? ''));

    if ($id && ($action === 'approve' || ($action === 'reject' && $reason !== ''))) {
        $bossStatus = $action === 'approve' ? 'approved' : 'rejected';
        $bossReason = $action === 'reject' ? $reason : null;
        $applicationStatus = $action === 'approve' ? 'pending_clerk' : 'rejected';
        $stmt = $conn->prepare(
            "UPDATE applications
             SET boss_status = ?, boss_reason = ?, application_status = ?
             WHERE id = ? AND boss_status = 'pending' AND application_status = 'submitted'
               AND is_resubmission = 1"
        );
        $stmt->bind_param('sssi', $bossStatus, $bossReason, $applicationStatus, $id);
        $stmt->execute();

        if ($stmt->affected_rows === 1) {
            $alert_msg = $action === 'approve'
                ? 'Resubmitted application approved successfully.'
                : 'Resubmitted application rejected successfully.';
            $alert_type = $action === 'approve' ? 'success' : 'error';
            if ($action === 'reject') {
                $notifStmt = $conn->prepare(
                    "INSERT INTO notifications (nic, title, message, is_read)
                     SELECT nic, 'Application Rejected',
                            CONCAT('Your resubmitted application was rejected by the Immediate Boss. Reason: ', ?),
                            0
                     FROM applications WHERE id = ?"
                );
                $notifStmt->bind_param('si', $reason, $id);
                $notifStmt->execute();
                $notifStmt->close();
            }
        } else {
            $alert_msg = 'This application is no longer awaiting your decision.';
            $alert_type = 'error';
        }
        $stmt->close();
    } elseif ($action === 'reject') {
        $alert_msg = 'A rejection reason is required.';
        $alert_type = 'error';
    }
}

$searchQuery = trim($_GET['search'] ?? '');
$sql = "SELECT a.id, a.application_no, a.nic, a.computer_no,
               u.name, u.applicant_designation
        FROM applications AS a
        INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.nic = a.nic
        WHERE a.boss_status = 'pending'
          AND a.application_status = 'submitted'
          AND a.is_resubmission = 1";

if ($searchQuery !== '') {
    $sql .= " AND (a.application_no LIKE ? OR a.nic LIKE ? OR a.computer_no LIKE ? OR u.name LIKE ?)";
    $searchTerm = '%' . $searchQuery . '%';
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
    $stmt->bind_param('ssss', $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm);
} else {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
}
$stmt->execute();
$displayData = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

<?php
/**
 * Application Approval Resubmitted List - Sri Lanka Railways (PF)
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// Page Title සැකසීම
$pageTitle = "Application Approval Resubmitted List - Sri Lanka Railways";

$alertMessage = '';
$alertType = '';
$conn = getDBConnection();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $action = $_POST['action'] ?? '';
    $actionId = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
    $reason = trim((string)($_POST['reason'] ?? ''));

    if ($actionId && ($action === 'approve' || ($action === 'reject' && $reason !== ''))) {
                $fileStatus = $action === 'approve' ? 'approved' : 'rejected';
        $fileReason = $action === 'reject' ? $reason : null;
        // Approve -> continues to Subject Clerk. Reject -> goes BACK TO THE IMMEDIATE BOSS (not the applicant).
        $applicationStatus = $action === 'approve' ? 'pending_clerk' : 'returned_to_boss';
        $stmt = $conn->prepare(
            "UPDATE applications
             SET file_status = ?, file_reason = ?, application_status = ?
             WHERE id = ? AND boss_status = 'approved'
               AND file_status = 'pending' AND is_resubmission = 1"
        );
        $stmt->bind_param('sssi', $fileStatus, $fileReason, $applicationStatus, $actionId);
        $stmt->execute();

                if ($stmt->affected_rows === 1) {
            $alertMessage = $action === 'approve'
                ? 'Resubmitted application approved successfully.'
                : 'Resubmitted application rejected successfully.';
            $alertType = $action === 'approve' ? 'success' : 'error';
        } else {
            $alertMessage = 'This application is no longer awaiting your decision.';
            $alertType = 'error';
        }
        $stmt->close();
    } elseif ($action === 'reject') {
        $alertMessage = 'A rejection reason is required.';
        $alertType = 'error';
    }
}

$searchQuery = isset($_GET['search']) ? trim($_GET['search']) : '';
$sql = "SELECT a.id, a.application_no, a.nic, a.computer_no, a.file_reason,
               a.boss_reason, u.name, u.applicant_designation
        FROM applications AS a
        INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.nic = a.nic
        WHERE a.boss_status = 'approved'
          AND a.file_status = 'pending'
          AND a.is_resubmission = 1
          AND a.application_status = 'pending_clerk'";

if ($searchQuery !== '') {
    $sql .= " AND (a.application_no LIKE ? OR a.nic LIKE ? OR a.computer_no LIKE ? OR u.name LIKE ?)";
    $searchTerm = '%' . $searchQuery . '%';
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
    $stmt->bind_param('ssss', $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm);
} else {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
}
$stmt->execute();
$filteredData = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

foreach ($filteredData as &$item) {
    $item['reason'] = $item['file_reason'] ?: ($item['boss_reason'] ?: '-');
}
unset($item);

<?php
/**
 * Returned From Personal File - Sri Lanka Railways
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "Returned From Personal File - Sri Lanka Railways";

$userData = [
    'name' => 'Immediate Boss',
    'role' => 'Sri Lanka Railways - AOT',
    'initials' => 'IB'
];

$user = [
    'name' => $userData['name']
];

$alert_msg = '';
$alert_type = '';
$conn = getDBConnection();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $action = $_POST['action'] ?? '';
    $id = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
    $reason = trim((string)($_POST['rejectionReason'] ?? ''));

    if ($id && ($action === 'approve' || ($action === 'reject' && $reason !== ''))) {
        if ($action === 'approve') {
            // Boss disagrees with Personal File: send it back to Personal File for a fresh decision.
            $stmt = $conn->prepare(
                "UPDATE applications
                    SET application_status = 'pending_clerk', file_status = 'pending'
                  WHERE id = ? AND application_status = 'returned_to_boss'"
            );
            $stmt->bind_param('i', $id);
        } else {
            // Boss agrees with the rejection: send it to the applicant to correct (file_reason is kept so they can see it).
            $stmt = $conn->prepare(
                "UPDATE applications
                    SET boss_status = 'rejected', boss_reason = ?, application_status = 'rejected'
                  WHERE id = ? AND application_status = 'returned_to_boss'"
            );
            $stmt->bind_param('si', $reason, $id);
        }
        $stmt->execute();

        if ($stmt->affected_rows === 1) {
            $alert_msg = $action === 'approve'
                ? 'Application sent back to Personal File.'
                : 'Application rejected and sent to the applicant for correction.';
            $alert_type = $action === 'approve' ? 'success' : 'error';
            if ($action === 'reject') {
                $notifStmt = $conn->prepare(
                    "INSERT INTO notifications (nic, title, message, is_read)
                     SELECT nic, 'Application Rejected',
                            CONCAT('Your application was rejected. Personal File reason: ', IFNULL(file_reason, '-'),
                                   ' | Immediate Boss reason: ', ?),
                            0
                     FROM applications WHERE id = ?"
                );
                $notifStmt->bind_param('si', $reason, $id);
                $notifStmt->execute();
                $notifStmt->close();
            }
        } else {
            $alert_msg = 'This application is no longer awaiting your decision.';
            $alert_type = 'error';
        }
        $stmt->close();
    } elseif ($action === 'reject') {
        $alert_msg = 'A rejection reason is required.';
        $alert_type = 'error';
    }
}

$searchQuery = trim($_GET['search'] ?? '');
$sql = "SELECT a.id, a.application_no, a.nic, a.computer_no, a.file_reason,
               u.name, u.applicant_designation
        FROM applications AS a
        INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.nic = a.nic
        WHERE a.application_status = 'returned_to_boss'
          AND a.file_status = 'rejected'";

if ($searchQuery !== '') {
    $sql .= " AND (a.application_no LIKE ? OR a.nic LIKE ? OR a.computer_no LIKE ? OR u.name LIKE ?)";
    $searchTerm = '%' . $searchQuery . '%';
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
    $stmt->bind_param('ssss', $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm, $searchTerm);
} else {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . ' ORDER BY a.application_date ASC, a.id ASC');
}
$stmt->execute();
$displayData = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

<script>
    function promptReject(id) {
        document.getElementById('rejectRowId').value = id;
        document.getElementById('rejectionReasonInput').value = '';
        document.getElementById('rejectModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeRejectModal() {
        document.getElementById('rejectModal').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('rejectRowId').value = '';
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const alertBox = document.getElementById('systemAlert');
        if (alertBox) {
            setTimeout(function() {
                alertBox.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(function() {
                    alertBox.style.display = 'none';
                }, 500);
            }, 2000);
        }
    });

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }
</script>

    function toggleDropdown() {

            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
        const compNoSpans = document.querySelectorAll('.computer-no');
        compNoSpans.forEach(span => {
            span.addEventListener('input', function() {
                this.textContent = this.textContent.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
            });
        });
    });
</script>

<?php
/**
 * System Users Management - Sri Lanka Railways
 * Lists all staff users (role_id BETWEEN 2 AND 7).
 */
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

$pageTitle = "System Users Management - Sri Lanka Railways";
$hide_admin_extras = true;

$conn = getDBConnection();

// Map role_id -> human label (matches src/helpers/roles.php)
$roleLabels = [
    2 => 'Super Admin',
    3 => 'Immediate Boss',
    4 => 'Personal File',
    5 => 'Subject Clerk',
    6 => 'Branch Officer',
    7 => 'Final Approval',
];

// ---- Handle delete (only staff, i.e. role_id BETWEEN 2 AND 7) ----
if (isset($_GET['delete']) && $_GET['delete'] !== '') {
    $deleteNic = trim((string) $_GET['delete']);

    $stmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM users WHERE nic = ? AND role_id BETWEEN 2 AND 7");
    $stmt->bind_param("s", $deleteNic);
    $stmt->execute();
    $deleted = $stmt->affected_rows;
    $stmt->close();

    $_SESSION['flash_message'] = $deleted
        ? 'System user deleted successfully!'
        : 'User could not be deleted (not found or not a staff role).';

    $conn->close();
    header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/system-users.php'));
    exit;
}

// ---- Search ----
$searchQuery = trim($_GET['search'] ?? '');

$sql = "SELECT nic, name, email, computer_number, mobile, role_id, created_at
          FROM users
         WHERE role_id BETWEEN 2 AND 7";

if ($searchQuery !== '') {
    $sql .= " AND (nic LIKE ? OR name LIKE ? OR email LIKE ?)";
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . " ORDER BY role_id ASC, created_at DESC");
    $like = '%' . $searchQuery . '%';
    $stmt->bind_param("sss", $like, $like, $like);
} else {
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql . " ORDER BY role_id ASC, created_at DESC");
}

$stmt->execute();
$systemUsers = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
$stmt->close();
$conn->close();

$flash_message = $_SESSION['flash_message'] ?? '';
unset($_SESSION['flash_message']);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

<script>
    function promptDelete(nic) {
        const modal = document.getElementById('deleteModal');
        document.getElementById('confirmDeleteBtn').href =
            "<?php echo baseUrl('admin/system-users.php'); ?>?delete=" + encodeURIComponent(nic);
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        modal.classList.add('flex');
    }

    function closeDeleteModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('deleteModal');
        modal.classList.remove('flex');
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    // Auto-hide toast
    setTimeout(() => {
        const alertBox = document.getElementById('alertBox');
        if (alertBox) {
            alertBox.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease';
            alertBox.style.opacity = '0';
            alertBox.style.transform = 'translateY(-20px)';
            setTimeout(() => alertBox.remove(), 500);
        }
    }, 4000);
</script>

<?php
/**
 * View Allocated Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways Admin
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$pageTitle = "View Allocated Quarter - Sri Lanka Railways Admin";

// Database connection (MySQL / PDO)
$host = 'localhost';
$dbname = 'admin_dashboard_db';
$username = 'root';
$password = '';

$item = null;
$recordId = isset($_GET['id']) ? intval($_GET['id']) : null;

try {
    $pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=$host;dbname=$dbname;charset=utf8mb4", $username, $password);
    $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

    if ($recordId !== null) {
        $stmt = $pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM allocated_quarters WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$recordId]);
        $item = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    // Fallback array data (ID 3 ekath ekata add karala thiyenne)
   
    if ($recordId !== null && isset($defaultAllocatedData[$recordId])) {
        $item = $defaultAllocatedData[$recordId];
    }
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const index = urlParams.get('id');
        
        const allocations = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('directAllocations')) || [];
        const viewContent = document.getElementById('viewContent');

        if (index !== null && allocations[index]) {
            const item = allocations[index];
            viewContent.innerHTML = `
                <div class="view-row"><div class="view-label">Auto ID:</div><div class="view-value">${parseInt(index) + 1}</div></div>
                <div class="view-row"><div class="view-label">NIC Number:</div><div class="view-value">${item.nic || '-'}</div></div>
                <div class="view-row"><div class="view-label">Computer Number:</div><div class="view-value">${item.computerNo || '-'}</div></div>
                <div class="view-row"><div class="view-label">Full Name:</div><div class="view-value">${item.fullName || '-'}</div></div>
                <div class="view-row"><div class="view-label">Quarter No.:</div><div class="view-value">${item.quarterNo || '-'}</div></div>
                <div class="view-row"><div class="view-label">Quarter Name:</div><div class="view-value">${item.quarterName || '-'}</div></div>
                <div class="view-row"><div class="view-label">Quarter Location:</div><div class="view-value">${item.quarterLocation || '-'}</div></div>
                <div class="view-row"><div class="view-label">Quarter Type:</div><div class="view-value">${item.quarterType || '-'}</div></div>

<?php
/**
 * View System User - Sri Lanka Railways
 */
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

$pageTitle = "View System User - Sri Lanka Railways";
$hide_admin_extras = true;

$nic = $_GET['nic'] ?? '';
$user_row = null;
$error = '';

$roles = [
    2 => 'Super Admin',
    3 => 'Immediate Boss',
    4 => 'Personal File',
    5 => 'Subject Clerk',
    6 => 'Branch Officer',
    7 => 'Final Approval',
];

if ($nic !== '') {
    $conn = getDBConnection();
    $stmt = $conn->prepare(
        "SELECT nic, name, email, computer_number, mobile, role_id, created_at
           FROM users
          WHERE nic = ? AND role_id BETWEEN 2 AND 7
          LIMIT 1"
    );
    $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
    $stmt->execute();
    $user_row = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
    $stmt->close();
    $conn->close();

    if (!$user_row) {
        $error = 'System user not found.';
    }
} else {
    $error = 'No NIC provided.';
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';

<?php
/**
 * View User Details - Sri Lanka Railways
 * Fetches a single applicant's details directly from the `users` table.
 */
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

$pageTitle = "View User Details - Sri Lanka Railways";

$nic = $_GET['nic'] ?? '';
$user_data = null;
$errorMessage = '';

if ($nic !== '') {
    $conn = getDBConnection();
    $stmt = $conn->prepare(
        "SELECT nic, name, email, computer_number, mobile, created_at
           FROM users
          WHERE nic = ? AND role_id = 1
          LIMIT 1"
    );
    $stmt->bind_param("s", $nic);
    $stmt->execute();
    $user_data = $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
    $stmt->close();
    $conn->close();

    if (!$user_data) {
        $errorMessage = "User not found for the provided NIC.";
    }
} else {
    $errorMessage = "No NIC provided. Please go back to the user list and click View on a row.";
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// Ensure admin session name exists (middleware normally sets this)
if (!isset($_SESSION['admin_name'])) {
    $_SESSION['admin_name'] = $_SESSION['user_name'] ?? 'Admin';
}

$admin_name = $_SESSION['admin_name'];

$user = [
    'name' => $admin_name
];

$pageTitle = "Registered Users - Sri Lanka Railways Admin";

// ---------------------------------------------------
// REAL DATABASE QUERIES
// ---------------------------------------------------
$conn = getDBConnection();

// ---------------------------------------------------
// Handle delete request (deletes by NIC, not by int id)
// ---------------------------------------------------
if (isset($_GET['action']) && $_GET['action'] === 'delete' && !empty($_GET['id'])) {
    $deleteNic = trim((string) $_GET['id']);   // KEEP as string — NIC is varchar

    if ($deleteNic !== '') {
        $delStmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM users WHERE nic = ? AND role_id = 1");
        if ($delStmt) {
            $delStmt->bind_param("s", $deleteNic);
            $delStmt->execute();
            $deleted = $delStmt->affected_rows;
            $delStmt->close();

            $_SESSION['flash_message'] = $deleted
                ? 'User record deleted successfully!'
                : 'User record could not be deleted (not found or not an applicant).';
        } else {
            $_SESSION['flash_message'] = 'Delete failed: ' . $conn->error;
        }
    } else {
        $_SESSION['flash_message'] = 'Invalid delete request.';
    }

    $conn->close();
    header('Location: ' . baseUrl('admin/view_users.php'));
    exit;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------
// Load all applicants (role_id = 1)
// ---------------------------------------------------
$applicants = [];
$result = $conn->query(
    "SELECT nic,
            name,
            email,
            computer_number,
            mobile,
            created_at
       FROM users
      WHERE role_id = 1
      ORDER BY created_at DESC"
);
if ($result) {
    $applicants = $result->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
}
$conn->close();

// Pull and clear the flash message
$flash_message = $_SESSION['flash_message'] ?? '';
unset($_SESSION['flash_message']);

// Hide the admin dashboard title and profile dropdown on inner pages
$hide_admin_extras = true;

// Include Admin Header
require_once __DIR__ . '/../layouts/admin_header.php';
?>

<!-- JavaScript Functions -->
<script>
    function filterTable() {
        let input = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase().trim();
        let tr = document.getElementById('userTable').getElementsByTagName('tr');

        for (let i = 1; i < tr.length; i++) {
            let tdNic  = tr[i].getElementsByTagName('td')[1]; // NIC column
            let tdName = tr[i].getElementsByTagName('td')[3]; // Name column

            if (tdNic && tdName) {
                let txtNic  = tdNic.textContent  || tdNic.innerText;
                let txtName = tdName.textContent || tdName.innerText;

                if (input === '' ||
                    txtNic.toLowerCase().indexOf(input)  > -1 ||
                    txtName.toLowerCase().indexOf(input) > -1) {
                    tr[i].style.display = '';
                } else {
                    tr[i].style.display = 'none';
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Clear filter as soon as the input is emptied
    document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', function () {
        if (this.value.trim() === '') {
            let tr = document.getElementById('userTable').getElementsByTagName('tr');
            for (let i = 1; i < tr.length; i++) {
                tr[i].style.display = '';
            }
        }
    });

    function openDeleteModal(nic) {
        // Build the delete URL pointing at the correct admin route
        let deleteUrl = "<?php echo baseUrl('admin/view_users.php'); ?>?action=delete&id=" + encodeURIComponent(nic);
        document.getElementById('confirmDeleteBtn').setAttribute('href', deleteUrl);
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').classList.remove('hidden');
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').classList.add('flex');
    }

    function closeDeleteModal() {
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').classList.remove('flex');
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    // Auto-hide the flash toast after 4 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
        let alertBox = document.getElementById('alertBox');
        if (alertBox) {
            alertBox.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease';
            alertBox.style.opacity = '0';
            alertBox.style.transform = 'translateY(-20px)';
            setTimeout(() => alertBox.remove(), 500);
        }
    }, 4000);
</script>

        designation VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

        allocated_date DATE NOT NULL,

    )");

// Function to fetch waiting list records from database[cite: 3, 5, 7]
function getWaitingLists($pdo, $listType, $search = '') {
    if (!$pdo) return [];
    
    try {
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM waiting_lists WHERE list_type = :list_type";
        $params = ['list_type' => $listType];
        
        if (!empty($search)) {
            $sql .= " AND (nic LIKE :search OR applicant_name LIKE :search)";
            $params['search'] = "%$search%";
        }
        $sql .= " ORDER BY id ASC";
        
        $stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        return [];
    }
}
