<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }

    function showTable(tableId, event) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.table-card').forEach(card => card.classList.remove('active-table'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
        document.getElementById(tableId).classList.add('active-table');
        event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
    }
</script>

<script>
    function toggleDropdown() {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.user-profile-wrapper')) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            }
        }
    });

    function openLogoutModal(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const dropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
        }
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeLogoutModal() {
        document.getElementById('logoutModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function executeLogout() {
        window.location.href = "login.php";
    }

    function showTable(tableId, event) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.table-card').forEach(card => card.classList.remove('active-table'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
        document.getElementById(tableId).classList.add('active-table');
        event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
    }
</script>

    function showTable(tableId, event) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.table-card').forEach(card => card.classList.remove('active-table'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
        document.getElementById(tableId).classList.add('active-table');
        event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
    }

    function openDeleteModal(listKey, id) {
        const deleteUrl = `?tab=${listKey}&action=delete&list=${listKey}&id=${id}`;
        document.getElementById('confirmDeleteBtn').setAttribute('href', deleteUrl);
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeDeleteModal() {
        document.getElementById('deleteModal').style.display = 'none';
    }
</script>

<!-- JavaScript for Search Logic -->
<script>
    // Sample database simulation for quarters
    const quartersData = {
        "Q-001": {
            no: "Q-001",
            nic: "199012345678",
            compNo: "C-1001",
            type: "Joint Residence",
            name: "S. Vihanga",
            designation: "Station Master",
            workplace: "Colombo Fort",
            allocatedDate: "2024-05-10",
            other: "Primary resident active with shared occupant approval."
        },
        "Q-002": {
            no: "Q-002",
            nic: "198587654321",
            compNo: "C-1002",
            type: "Joint Residence",
            name: "A. B. Perera",
            designation: "Signal Inspector",
            workplace: "Maradana",
            allocatedDate: "2023-11-15",
            other: "Standard joint allocation agreement completed."
        }
    };

    // Function to handle Enter key press event
    function handleKeyPress(event) {
        if (event.key === 'Enter') {
            searchQuarter();
        }
    }

    function searchQuarter() {
        const query = document.getElementById('quarterSearchInput').value.trim();
        const resultBox = document.getElementById('resultContainer');
        const errorMsg = document.getElementById('errorMsg');

        if (quartersData[query]) {
            const data = quartersData[query];
            document.getElementById('resNo').innerText = data.no;
            document.getElementById('resNic').innerText = data.nic;
            document.getElementById('resCompNo').innerText = data.compNo;
            document.getElementById('resType').innerText = data.type;
            document.getElementById('resName').innerText = data.name;
            document.getElementById('resDesignation').innerText = data.designation;
            document.getElementById('resWorkplace').innerText = data.workplace;
            document.getElementById('resDate').innerText = data.allocatedDate;
            document.getElementById('resOther').innerText = data.other;

            resultBox.classList.remove('hidden');
            errorMsg.classList.add('hidden');
        } else {
            resultBox.classList.add('hidden');
            errorMsg.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
    }
</script>

        let currentPage = 1;
        
                // Show the page/section of the first invalid field when Submit is clicked
        document.querySelector('.submit-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
            const firstInvalid = document.querySelector('#railway-form input:invalid, #railway-form select:invalid, #railway-form textarea:invalid');
            if (!firstInvalid) return;

            const page = firstInvalid.closest('.page-section');
            if (page) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.page-section').forEach(p => p.style.display = 'none');
                page.style.display = 'block';
            }

            let el = firstInvalid.parentElement;
            while (el && el.id !== 'railway-form') {
                if (el.style && el.style.display === 'none') el.style.display = 'block';
                el = el.parentElement;
            }
        });

        window.onload = function() {
            const userData = {
                full_name: "<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['full_name'] ?? $_SESSION['user_name'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES); ?>",
                computer_no: "<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['computer_no'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES); ?>",
                national_id: "<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['national_id'] ?? $_SESSION['nic'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES); ?>",
                phone_no: "<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['phone_no'] ?? $_SESSION['user_phone'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES); ?>"
            };
            
            if (userData.full_name) document.getElementById('full_name').value = userData.full_name;
            if (userData.computer_no) document.getElementById('computer_no').value = userData.computer_no;
            if (userData.national_id) document.getElementById('national_id').value = userData.national_id;
            if (userData.phone_no) document.getElementById('phone_no').value = userData.phone_no;
        };

        function handleEnter(event, nextFieldId) {
            if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                event.preventDefault();
                const nextField = document.getElementsByName(nextFieldId)[0] || document.getElementById(nextFieldId);
                if (nextField) {
                    nextField.focus();
                }
            }
        }

     function setMinDate(fromId, targetIds) {
        const from = document.getElementById(fromId);
        if (!from) return;
        const val = from.value;
        targetIds.forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) el.min = val;
        });
        }

        function toggleOwnerRelationship(show) {
            document.getElementById('owner-relationship-group').style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none';
        }

        function showRenameHint(element, message) {
            element.title = message;
        }

        function hideRenameHint(element) {
            // Optional additional logic can go here
        }

        function changePage(currentId, targetId) {
            document.getElementById(currentId).style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById(targetId).style.display = 'block';
            window.scrollTo(0, 0);
        }

        function toggleTable(tableId, show) {
            document.getElementById(tableId).style.display = show ? "block" : "none";
        }

        function addTableRow(tableId) {
            const table = document.getElementById(tableId).getElementsByTagName('tbody')[0];
            const newRow = table.insertRow();
            const isBreak = tableId === 'table-vi-element';
            const deptName = isBreak ? 'break_sub_department' : 'sub_department_name';
            const fromName = isBreak ? 'break_from_date' : 'service_from_date';
            const toName = isBreak ? 'break_to_date' : 'service_to_date';
            const departments = <?php echo json_encode(array_column($subDepartments, 'name'), JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_QUOT); ?>;
            const options = departments.map(name => `<option value="${name}">${name}</option>`).join('');
            newRow.innerHTML = `
                <td><select class="dropdown-select table-select" name="${deptName}[]"><option value="" disabled selected>-- Select --</option>${options}</select></td>
                <td><input type="date" name="${fromName}[]" class="form-input-date from-date" onchange="validateToDate(this)"></td>
                <td><input type="date" name="${toName}[]" class="form-input-date to-date"></td>
            `;
        }

        function removeTableRow(tableId) {
            const rows = document.getElementById(tableId).getElementsByTagName('tbody')[0].rows;
            if (rows.length > 1) rows[rows.length - 1].remove();
        }

    function toggleContainer(containerId, show) {
        const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
        container.style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (!show) {
            container.querySelectorAll('input[type="date"]').forEach(i => { i.value = ''; i.min = ''; });
        }
        if (containerId === 'children-details' && show) {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('children-tbody');
            if (tbody.rows.length === 0) generateChildRows();
        }
    }

        function handleCivilStatus(status) {
            document.getElementById('married-sections').style.display = 'block';
        }

        function printApplication() {
            window.print();
        }

        // Generate rows based on child count
        function generateChildRows() {
            const countInput = document.getElementById('child-count-input');
            const tbody = document.getElementById('children-tbody');
            tbody.innerHTML = ''; 
            
            const count = parseInt(countInput.value) || 0;
            
            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                row.innerHTML = `
                    <td><input type="text" class="form-input" name="child_full_name[]" style="width: 100%;"></td>
                    <td>
                        <select class="dropdown-select table-select" name="child_gender[]">
                            <option value="" disabled selected>-- Select --</option>
                            <option value="male">Male</option>
                            <option value="female">Female</option>
                        </select>
                    </td>
                    <td><input type="date" class="form-input-date" name="child_date_of_birth[]"></td>
                    <td>
                        <select class="dropdown-select table-select" name="child_civil_status[]">
                            <option value="" disabled selected>-- Select --</option>
                            <option value="unmarried">Unmarried</option>
                            <option value="married">Married</option>
                            <option value="divorced">Divorced</option>
                            <option value="widowed">Widowed</option>
                        </select>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        <button type="button" class="clear-row-btn" onclick="clearChildRow(this)">Clear</button>
                    </td>
                `;
                tbody.appendChild(row);
            }
        }

        // Clear data only for the specific row
        function clearChildRow(button) {
            const row = button.closest('tr');
            const inputs = row.querySelectorAll('input, select');
            inputs.forEach(input => {
                if (input.type === 'text' || input.type === 'date') {
                    input.value = '';
                } else if (input.tagName === 'SELECT') {
                    input.selectedIndex = 0;
                }
            });
        }

        // Manage To Date when From Date changes
        function validateToDate(fromInput) {
            const row = fromInput.closest('tr');
            const toInput = row.querySelector('.to-date');
            
            if (fromInput.value) {
                toInput.min = fromInput.value;
                if (toInput.value && toInput.value < fromInput.value) {
                    toInput.value = '';
                }
            } else {
                toInput.removeAttribute('min');
            }
        }

                    <div class="section-title">10. ප්‍රකාශය </div>
                    <div class="form-group full-width declaration-text" style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8;">
                        <p>මා හට දුම්රිය නිවාසයක් වෙන් කරනු ලැබුවහොත්,</p>
                        <p>I. මගේ පවුලේ සාමාජිකයින් සමග පදිංචිව සිටින බවත්,</p>
                        <p>II. දැනුම් දීමකින් තොරව, නඩත්තු කරුවන් හෝ පිටස්තර පුද්ගලයින් එහි පදිංචි කර නොගන්නා බවත්,</p>
                        <p>III. මෙම ඉල්ලුම්පත්‍රයේ සඳහන් කරුණු (වේතනය වෙනස් වීම, දරුවන්ගේ උපත්, විවාහයන්, අභාවයන්, දික්කසාද වීම හා දරුවන්ගේ කලත්‍රයා රැකියාවක යෙදීම) මින් පසුව වෙනස් වුවහොත්, ඒ පිළිබඳව වාර්තා කිරීමටත්,</p>
                        <p>IV. දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව මගින් දැනුම් දීමෙන් පසුව හෝ අවශ්‍ය වූ විටක, මගේ යැපෙන්නන් සමඟ මෙම නිවාසයෙන් ඉවත්ව, එය හිස් කර භාර දීමේ කොන්දේසියට යටත්ව භාර ගනිමි.</p>
                        
                        <div style="margin-top: 15px; line-height: 2.2;">
                            ඉහත සඳහන් කර ඇති තොරතුරු සත්‍ය හා නිවැරදි බවත්, වැරදි ප්‍රකාශයක් කළ බවට තහවුරු වුවහොත්, කෙදිනක හෝ මට විරුද්ධව විනයානුකූලව කටයුතු කරනු ලැබීමට ඉඩ ඇති බවට මම දැනුවත් බවත් මෙයින් ප්‍රකාශ කරමි. මම දැනට වෙනත් දුම්රිය නිවාසයක ප්‍රධාන පදිංචිකරු නොවන බව ද සහතික කරමි.

        let currentPage = 1;
        
        document.querySelector('.submit-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
            const firstInvalid = document.querySelector('#railway-form input:invalid, #railway-form select:invalid, #railway-form textarea:invalid');
            if (!firstInvalid) return;

            const page = firstInvalid.closest('.page-section');
            if (page) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.page-section').forEach(p => p.style.display = 'none');
                page.style.display = 'block';
            }

            let el = firstInvalid.parentElement;
            while (el && el.id !== 'railway-form') {
                if (el.style && el.style.display === 'none') el.style.display = 'block';
                el = el.parentElement;
            }
        });

        window.onload = function() {
            const userData = {
                full_name: "<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['full_name'] ?? $_SESSION['user_name'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES); ?>",
                computer_no: "<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['computer_no'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES); ?>",
                national_id: "<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['national_id'] ?? $_SESSION['nic'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES); ?>",
                phone_no: "<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['phone_no'] ?? $_SESSION['user_phone'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES); ?>"
            };
            
            if (userData.full_name) document.getElementById('full_name').value = userData.full_name;
            if (userData.computer_no) document.getElementById('computer_no').value = userData.computer_no;
            if (userData.national_id) document.getElementById('national_id').value = userData.national_id;
            if (userData.phone_no) document.getElementById('phone_no').value = userData.phone_no;
        };

        function handleEnter(event, nextFieldId) {
            if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                event.preventDefault();
                const nextField = document.getElementsByName(nextFieldId)[0] || document.getElementById(nextFieldId);
                if (nextField) {
                    nextField.focus();
                }
            }
        }

        function setMinDate(fromId, targetIds) {
            const from = document.getElementById(fromId);
            if (!from) return;
            const val = from.value;
            targetIds.forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.min = val;
            });
        }

        function toggleOwnerRelationship(show) {
            document.getElementById('owner-relationship-group').style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none';
        }

        function showRenameHint(element, message) {
            element.title = message;
        }

        function hideRenameHint(element) {
        }

        function changePage(currentId, targetId) {
            document.getElementById(currentId).style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById(targetId).style.display = 'block';
            window.scrollTo(0, 0);
        }

        function toggleTable(tableId, show) {
            document.getElementById(tableId).style.display = show ? "block" : "none";
        }

        function addTableRow(tableId) {
            const table = document.getElementById(tableId).getElementsByTagName('tbody')[0];
            const newRow = table.insertRow();
            const isBreak = tableId === 'table-vi-element';
            const deptName = isBreak ? 'break_sub_department' : 'sub_department_name';
            const fromName = isBreak ? 'break_from_date' : 'service_from_date';
            const toName = isBreak ? 'break_to_date' : 'service_to_date';
            const departments = <?php echo json_encode(array_column($subDepartments, 'name'), JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_QUOT); ?>;
            const options = departments.map(name => `<option value="${name}">${name}</option>`).join('');
            newRow.innerHTML = `
                <td><select class="dropdown-select table-select" name="${deptName}[]"><option value="" disabled selected>-- තෝරන්න --</option>${options}</select></td>
                <td><input type="date" name="${fromName}[]" class="form-input-date from-date" onchange="validateToDate(this)"></td>
                <td><input type="date" name="${toName}[]" class="form-input-date to-date"></td>
            `;
        }

        function removeTableRow(tableId) {
            const rows = document.getElementById(tableId).getElementsByTagName('tbody')[0].rows;
            if (rows.length > 1) rows[rows.length - 1].remove();
        }

        function toggleContainer(containerId, show) {
            const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
            container.style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none';
            if (!show) {
                container.querySelectorAll('input[type="date"]').forEach(i => { i.value = ''; i.min = ''; });
            }
            if (containerId === 'children-details' && show) {
                const tbody = document.getElementById('children-tbody');
                if (tbody.rows.length === 0) generateChildRows();
            }
        }

        function handleCivilStatus(status) {
            document.getElementById('married-sections').style.display = 'block';
        }

        function printApplication() {
            window.print();
        }

        function generateChildRows() {
            const countInput = document.getElementById('child-count-input');
            const tbody = document.getElementById('children-tbody');
            tbody.innerHTML = ''; 
            
            const count = parseInt(countInput.value) || 0;
            
            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                row.innerHTML = `
                    <td><input type="text" class="form-input" name="child_full_name[]" style="width: 100%;"></td>
                    <td>
                        <select class="dropdown-select table-select" name="child_gender[]">
                            <option value="" disabled selected>-- තෝරන්න --</option>
                            <option value="male">පුරුෂ</option>
                            <option value="female">ස්ත්‍රී</option>
                        </select>
                    </td>
                    <td><input type="date" class="form-input-date" name="child_date_of_birth[]"></td>
                    <td>
                        <select class="dropdown-select table-select" name="child_civil_status[]">
                            <option value="" disabled selected>-- තෝරන්න --</option>
                            <option value="unmarried">අවිවාහක</option>
                            <option value="married">විවාහක</option>
                            <option value="divorced">දික්කසාද</option>
                            <option value="widowed">වැන්දඹු</option>
                        </select>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        <button type="button" class="clear-row-btn" onclick="clearChildRow(this)">Clear</button>
                    </td>
                `;
                tbody.appendChild(row);
            }
        }

        function clearChildRow(button) {
            const row = button.closest('tr');
            const inputs = row.querySelectorAll('input, select');
            inputs.forEach(input => {
                if (input.type === 'text' || input.type === 'date') {
                    input.value = '';
                } else if (input.tagName === 'SELECT') {
                    input.selectedIndex = 0;
                }
            });
        }

        function validateToDate(fromInput) {
            const row = fromInput.closest('tr');
            const toInput = row.querySelector('.to-date');
            
            if (fromInput.value) {
                toInput.min = fromInput.value;
                if (toInput.value && toInput.value < fromInput.value) {
                    toInput.value = '';
                }
            } else {
                toInput.removeAttribute('min');
            }
        }

<!-- JavaScript for Tab Switching -->
<script>
    function switchTab(tabName) {
        const contents = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content');
        contents.forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));

        const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
        buttons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));

        document.getElementById('content-' + tabName).classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById('btn-' + tabName).classList.add('active');
    }
</script>

<?php
/**
 * Login Page with Security Features
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../../config/config.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../helpers/roles.php';

// Session is already started in index.php

$pageTitle = 'Login - Quarter Management System';

// If already logged in, redirect to the role's dashboard
if (isset($_SESSION['nic']) && isset($_SESSION['session_valid'])) {
    header('Location: ' . baseUrl(roleHomePath(currentRoleId() ?: 1)));
    exit();
}

$error = '';
$showCaptcha = false;

// Generate CSRF token function
function generateCsrfToken() {
    if (!isset($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
        $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
    }
    return $_SESSION['csrf_token'];
}

function verifyCsrfToken($token) {
    if (!isset($_SESSION['csrf_token']) || empty($token)) {
        return false;
    }
    return hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $token);
}

// Handle login form submission
if ($_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "POST") {
    require_once __DIR__ . '/../../controllers/AuthController.php';
    $auth = new AuthController();
    
    $nic = trim($_POST['nic'] ?? '');
    $password = trim($_POST['password'] ?? '');
    
    // CSRF Protection
    if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || !verifyCsrfToken($_POST['csrf_token'])) {
        $error = 'Security token validation failed. Please try again.';
    } else {
        $result = $auth->login($nic, $password);
        if ($result['success']) {
            $roleId = currentRoleId();

            if ($roleId === ROLE_APPLICANT) {
                // applicants return to the page they originally wanted
                $redirect = $_SESSION['redirect_after_login'] ?? '/dashboard';
                unset($_SESSION['redirect_after_login']);
                $redirect = ltrim($redirect, '/');
                if (empty($redirect) || $redirect === 'dashboard') {
                    $redirect = 'dashboard';
                }
            } else {
                // staff always go to their own dashboard
                unset($_SESSION['redirect_after_login']);
                $redirect = roleHomePath($roleId);
            }

            header('Location: ' . baseUrl($redirect));
            exit();
        } else {
            $error = $result['message'];
            // Show captcha after 3 failed attempts (client-side tracking)
            $showCaptcha = isset($_POST['attempt_count']) && $_POST['attempt_count'] >= 2;
        }
    }
}

$csrfToken = generateCsrfToken();
?>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title><?php echo $pageTitle; ?></title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-100 min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center">

    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-8 max-w-md w-full border-t-4 border-[#b59410]">
        <!-- Logo -->
        <div class="text-center mb-8">
            <img src="<?php echo assetUrl('images/logo.png'); ?>" alt="Railway Logo" class="h-20 mx-auto mb-4">
            <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-[#5c060d]">SRI LANKA RAILWAY</h1>
            <p class="text-sm text-gray-500">Quarter Management System</p>
        </div>

        <?php if ($error): ?>
            <div class="mb-4 p-3 bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-center">
                <i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle mr-2"></i>
                <?php echo htmlspecialchars($error); ?>
            </div>
        <?php endif; ?>

        <form method="POST" action="<?php echo baseUrl('login'); ?>" id="loginForm" class="space-y-4">
            <!-- CSRF Token -->
            <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="<?php echo $csrfToken; ?>">
            <input type="hidden" name="attempt_count" id="attemptCount" value="0">
            
            <div>
                <label for="nic" class="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">
                    <i class="fas fa-id-card mr-2"></i> NIC Number
                </label>
                <input type="text" 
                       id="nic"

                       value="<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_POST['nic'] ?? ''); ?>"

                    Register here
                </a>
            </p>

            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono">NIC: 199012345678 | Password: password123</p>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        let attemptCount = 0;
        
        // Toggle password visibility
        function togglePasswordVisibility() {
            const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');
            const icon = document.getElementById('passwordToggleIcon');
            
            if (passwordInput.type === 'password') {
                passwordInput.type = 'text';
                icon.className = 'fas fa-eye-slash';
            } else {
                passwordInput.type = 'password';
                icon.className = 'fas fa-eye';
            }
        }
        
        // Track login attempts
        document.getElementById('loginForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            attemptCount++;
            document.getElementById('attemptCount').value = attemptCount;
        });
        
        // Refresh captcha
        function refreshCaptcha() {
            const captchaText = document.getElementById('captchaText');
            const newCode = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
            captchaText.textContent = newCode;
        }
        
        // Prevent multiple submissions
        document.getElementById('loginForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            const button = document.getElementById('loginButton');
            if (button.disabled) {
                e.preventDefault();
                return;
            }
            button.disabled = true;
            button.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-2"></i> Logging in...';
        });
    </script>

</body>

        $data = [
            'name' => trim($_POST['name'] ?? ''),
            'nic' => trim($_POST['nic'] ?? ''),
            'email' => trim($_POST['email'] ?? ''),
            'computer_number' => trim($_POST['computer_number'] ?? ''),
            'mobile' => trim($_POST['mobile'] ?? ''),
            'password' => $_POST['password'] ?? '',
            'confirm_password' => $_POST['confirm_password'] ?? ''
        ];
        
        $formData = $data;
        $result = $auth->register($data);
        
        if ($result['success']) {
            // Clear form data
            $formData = [];
            // Redirect to login with success message
            redirect('/login?registered=success');
            exit();
        } else {
            $error = $result['message'];
        }
    }
}

// Generate CSRF token
function generateCsrfToken() {
    if (!isset($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
        $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
    }
    return $_SESSION['csrf_token'];
}

function verifyCsrfToken($token) {
    if (!isset($_SESSION['csrf_token']) || empty($token)) {
        return false;
    }
    return hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $token);
}

$csrfToken = generateCsrfToken();

    <script>
        // Toggle password visibility
        function togglePasswordVisibility(fieldId) {
            const input = document.getElementById(fieldId);
            const icon = document.getElementById(fieldId + 'ToggleIcon');
            
            if (input.type === 'password') {
                input.type = 'text';
                if (icon) icon.className = 'fas fa-eye-slash';
            } else {
                input.type = 'password';
                if (icon) icon.className = 'fas fa-eye';
            }
        }

        // Password strength checker
        const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');
        const confirmInput = document.getElementById('confirm_password');
        const strengthBar = document.getElementById('strengthBar');
        const strengthText = document.getElementById('strengthText');

        function checkPasswordStrength(password) {
            let score = 0;
            const checks = {
                length: password.length >= 8,
                upper: /[A-Z]/.test(password),
                lower: /[a-z]/.test(password),
                number: /[0-9]/.test(password)
            };
            
            // Update requirements list
            document.getElementById('req-length').innerHTML = 
                `<i class="fas fa-${checks.length ? 'check-circle text-green-500' : 'circle text-[8px]'}"></i> At least 8 characters`;
            document.getElementById('req-upper').innerHTML = 
                `<i class="fas fa-${checks.upper ? 'check-circle text-green-500' : 'circle text-[8px]'}"></i> One uppercase letter`;
            document.getElementById('req-lower').innerHTML = 
                `<i class="fas fa-${checks.lower ? 'check-circle text-green-500' : 'circle text-[8px]'}"></i> One lowercase letter`;
            document.getElementById('req-number').innerHTML = 
                `<i class="fas fa-${checks.number ? 'check-circle text-green-500' : 'circle text-[8px]'}"></i> One number`;
            
            // Calculate score
            if (checks.length) score++;
            if (checks.upper) score++;
            if (checks.lower) score++;
            if (checks.number) score++;
            
            // Update strength bar
            const percentage = (score / 4) * 100;
            strengthBar.style.width = percentage + '%';
            
            const colors = {
                0: 'bg-red-500',
                1: 'bg-red-400',
                2: 'bg-yellow-500',
                3: 'bg-blue-500',
                4: 'bg-green-500'
            };
            const labels = ['', 'Weak', 'Fair', 'Good', 'Strong'];
            
            strengthBar.className = 'h-full rounded-full ' + (colors[score] || 'bg-gray-300');
            strengthText.textContent = labels[score] || '';
            strengthText.className = 'text-xs font-semibold ' + 
                (score >= 3 ? 'text-green-600' : score >= 2 ? 'text-yellow-600' : 'text-red-600');
            
            return checks;
        }

        passwordInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
            checkPasswordStrength(this.value);
        });

        // Confirm password validation
        confirmInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
            if (this.value && this.value !== passwordInput.value) {
                this.className = 'w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 border-red-500 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500 focus:border-transparent transition pr-12';
            } else if (this.value && this.value === passwordInput.value) {
                this.className = 'w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 border-green-500 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-500 focus:border-transparent transition pr-12';
            } else {
                this.className = 'w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#b59410] focus:border-transparent transition pr-12';
            }
        });

        // Prevent multiple submissions
        document.getElementById('registerForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            const button = document.getElementById('registerButton');
            if (button.disabled) {
                e.preventDefault();
                return;
            }
            
            // Validate password match
            if (passwordInput.value !== confirmInput.value) {
                e.preventDefault();
                alert('Passwords do not match!');
                return;
            }
            
            // Validate terms
            if (!document.getElementById('terms').checked) {
                e.preventDefault();
                alert('Please agree to the Terms and Conditions');
                return;
            }
            
            button.disabled = true;
            button.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-2"></i> Registering...';
        });
    </script>

</body>
</html>

            const otherContainer = document.getElementById('other-issue-container');
            const customInput = document.getElementById('custom_issue');
            
            if (this.value === 'other') {
                otherContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
                customInput.setAttribute('required', 'required');
            } else {
                otherContainer.classList.add('hidden');
                customInput.removeAttribute('required');

/**
 * View Status Page

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../controllers/ApplicationController.php';

$appController = new ApplicationController();

// Applications are owned by the user's NIC in the database and session.
$nic = $_SESSION['nic'] ?? null;
$application = $nic ? $appController->getStatus() : null;

$user = [
    'name' => $_SESSION['user_name'] ?? 'User'
];

$userName = $user['name'] ?? 'User';
$pageTitle = 'View Status';

// Fetch waiting list position and marks from application data
$waitingListPosition = $application['position'] ?? 'N/A';
$marks = $application['marks'] ?? '0';

// Define the approval steps with darker/stronger success color themes (thada pata)
$rawSteps = [
    1 => ['name' => 'Application Submit', 'key' => 'submit', 'icon' => 'fa-file-lines', 'contact' => '011 234 5678', 'color' => 'blue', 'bg' => 'bg-blue-600', 'border' => 'border-blue-600', 'badge_bg' => 'bg-blue-200 text-blue-900 border-blue-400', 'row_bg' => 'border-blue-400 bg-blue-100/80'],
    2 => ['name' => 'Immediate Boss', 'key' => 'boss', 'icon' => 'fa-user-tie', 'contact' => '011 234 5679', 'color' => 'purple', 'bg' => 'bg-purple-600', 'border' => 'border-purple-600', 'badge_bg' => 'bg-purple-200 text-purple-900 border-purple-400', 'row_bg' => 'border-purple-400 bg-purple-100/80'],
    3 => ['name' => 'Personal File', 'key' => 'file', 'icon' => 'fa-folder-open', 'contact' => '011 234 5680', 'color' => 'emerald', 'bg' => 'bg-emerald-600', 'border' => 'border-emerald-600', 'badge_bg' => 'bg-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 border-emerald-400', 'row_bg' => 'border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-100/80'],
    4 => ['name' => 'Subject Clerk', 'key' => 'clerk', 'icon' => 'fa-user-pen', 'contact' => '011 234 5681', 'color' => 'indigo', 'bg' => 'bg-indigo-600', 'border' => 'border-indigo-600', 'badge_bg' => 'bg-indigo-200 text-indigo-900 border-indigo-400', 'row_bg' => 'border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-100/80'],
    5 => ['name' => 'Branch Officer', 'key' => 'branch', 'icon' => 'fa-building-columns', 'contact' => '011 234 5682', 'color' => 'amber', 'bg' => 'bg-amber-600', 'border' => 'border-amber-600', 'badge_bg' => 'bg-amber-200 text-amber-900 border-amber-400', 'row_bg' => 'border-amber-400 bg-amber-100/80'],
    6 => ['name' => 'Final Approver', 'key' => 'final', 'icon' => 'fa-award', 'contact' => '011 234 5683', 'color' => 'rose', 'bg' => 'bg-rose-600', 'border' => 'border-rose-600', 'badge_bg' => 'bg-rose-200 text-rose-900 border-rose-400', 'row_bg' => 'border-rose-400 bg-rose-100/80']
];

// Build status array with proper logic
$steps = [];
$isRejectedChain = false;
$inProgressAssigned = false;

// Get statuses from application or default to pending
$subStatus = $application['submit_status'] ?? (
    ($application['application_status'] ?? '') === 'submitted' ? 'success' : 'pending'
);
$bStatus = $application['boss_status'] ?? 'pending';
$fStatus = $application['file_status'] ?? 'pending';
$cStatus = $application['clerk_status'] ?? 'pending';
$brStatus = $application['branch_status'] ?? 'pending';
$fnStatus = $application['final_status'] ?? 'pending';

$statusMap = [
    1 => $subStatus,
    2 => $bStatus,
    3 => $fStatus,
    4 => $cStatus,
    5 => $brStatus,
    6 => $fnStatus
];

foreach ($rawSteps as $id => $stepInfo) {
    $st = $statusMap[$id] ?? 'pending';
    
    // If any step is rejected, all subsequent steps become rejected
    if ($isRejectedChain) {
        $st = 'rejected';
    }
    
    if ($st === 'rejected' && !$isRejectedChain) {
        $isRejectedChain = true;
    }

    // Mark the first pending step as 'in-progress'
    if (!$isRejectedChain) {
        if ($st === 'pending' && !$inProgressAssigned) {
            $st = 'in-progress';
            $inProgressAssigned = true;
        } elseif ($st === 'in-progress') {
            $inProgressAssigned = true;
        }
    }

    // Get rejection reason if applicable
    $stepReason = null;
    if ($st === 'rejected') {
        $stepReason = $application[$stepInfo['key'] . '_reason'] ?? 'This step was rejected or stopped due to previous stage issues.';
    }

    $steps[$id] = [
        'name' => $stepInfo['name'],
        'icon' => $stepInfo['icon'],
        'status' => $st,
        'contact' => $stepInfo['contact'],
        'reason' => $stepReason,
        'color' => $stepInfo['color'],
        'bg' => $stepInfo['bg'],
        'border' => $stepInfo['border'],
        'badge_bg' => $stepInfo['badge_bg'],
        'row_bg' => $stepInfo['row_bg']
    ];
}

// Conditions for showing Marks and Waiting List Position
$isSubmitted = ($subStatus === 'success' || $subStatus === 'approved');
$isFinalApproved = ($fnStatus === 'success' || $fnStatus === 'approved');

// Set flag to hide dashboard-specific header action icons/profile on this inner page
$hideHeaderActions = true;

                    <div class="absolute top-1/2 left-12 h-1.5 bg-emerald-600 -translate-y-1/2 z-0 rounded-full transition-all duration-500" style="width: calc(<?= $progressPercent; ?>% - 24px);"></div>

        window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {

<?php
/**
 * Notifications Page
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../controllers/NotificationController.php';

$notificationController = new NotificationController();
$notifications = $notificationController->getAll();

// Handle AJAX requests
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['ajax_action'])) {
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    $targetId = isset($_POST['action_id']) ? (int)$_POST['action_id'] : 0;
    
    if ($_POST['ajax_action'] === 'mark_read' && $targetId > 0) {
        $result = $notificationController->markAsRead($targetId);
        echo json_encode($result);
        exit();
    } 
    elseif ($_POST['ajax_action'] === 'delete' && $targetId > 0) {
        $result = $notificationController->delete($targetId);
        echo json_encode($result);
        exit();
    }
}

$user = $_SESSION['user_name'] ?? 'User';
$pageTitle = 'Notifications';

include __DIR__ . '/../layouts/header.php';
?>

    <div id="deleteModal" style="display: none;" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 transition-all duration-300">
        <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full p-8 text-center transform transition-all border border-gray-100 mx-4">
            <div class="flex justify-center mb-5">
                <div class="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-red-50 flex items-center justify-center text-red-600 text-2xl shadow-inner border border-red-100">
                    <i class="fas fa-trash-alt"></i>
                </div>
            </div>
            <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">Delete Notification</h3>
            <p class="text-gray-500 text-sm mb-8 leading-relaxed">Are you sure you want to delete this message? </p>
            <div class="flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
                <button id="cancelDeleteBtn" type="button" class="flex-1 px-5 py-3 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 text-sm">
                    Cancel
                </button>
                <button id="confirmDeleteBtn" type="button" class="flex-1 px-5 py-3 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 shadow-lg shadow-red-600/25 text-sm">
                    Yes, Delete
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        let currentDeleteId = null;
        const deleteModal = document.getElementById('deleteModal');

        // Event listener for all delete buttons
        document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
            let btn = event.target.closest('.delete-trigger-btn');
            if (btn) {
                currentDeleteId = btn.getAttribute('data-id');
                deleteModal.style.display = 'flex';
            }
        });

        // Modal Cancel Button Event
        document.getElementById('cancelDeleteBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            deleteModal.style.display = 'none';
            currentDeleteId = null;
        });

        // Modal Confirm Delete Button Event
        document.getElementById('confirmDeleteBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            deleteModal.style.display = 'none';
            if (currentDeleteId) {
                executeAction(currentDeleteId, 'delete');
                currentDeleteId = null;
            }
        });

        function markAsRead(id) {
            executeAction(id, 'mark_read');
        }

        function executeAction(id, action) {
            let formData = new URLSearchParams();
            formData.append('ajax_action', action);
            formData.append('action_id', id);

            fetch('', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData
            })
            .then(response => response.json())
            .then(data => {
                if (data.status === 'success') {
                    if (action === 'mark_read') {
                        document.getElementById('status-text-' + id).innerHTML = 
                            '<span class="text-xs font-semibold text-green-600 bg-green-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-green-200"><i class="fas fa-check-circle mr-1"></i> Read</span>';
                        let readBtnWrap = document.getElementById('mark-read-btn-wrap-' + id);
                        if (readBtnWrap) readBtnWrap.innerHTML = '';
                    } else if (action === 'delete') {
                        let box = document.getElementById('notif-box-' + id);
                        if (box) box.remove();
                        
                        let container = document.getElementById('notificationsContainer');
                        if (container && container.querySelectorAll('[id^="notif-box-"]').length === 0) {
                            location.reload();
                        }
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(error => {
                console.error('Error:', error);
            });
        }
    </script>

<?php include __DIR__ . '/../layouts/footer.php'; ?>

<?php
/**
 * Edit Profile Page
 */
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../controllers/ProfileController.php';

$profileController = new ProfileController();
$userData = $profileController->getProfile();
$error = '';
$success = '';

if ($_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "POST") {
    $email = trim($_POST['email'] ?? '');
    $computer_no = trim($_POST['computer_no'] ?? '');
    $mobile = trim($_POST['mobile'] ?? '');
    $whatsapp = trim($_POST['whatsapp'] ?? '');
    $password = $_POST['password'] ?? '';
    $confirm_password = $_POST['confirm_password'] ?? '';
    
    // Retain existing Name and NIC since users are not allowed to change them
    $name = $userData['name'] ?? '';
    $nic = $userData['nic'] ?? '';
    
    if (!empty($password) && $password !== $confirm_password) {
        $error = "Passwords do not match! Please check again.";
    } elseif ($email && $computer_no && $mobile && $whatsapp) {
        $result = $profileController->updateProfile($name, $nic, $email, $computer_no, $mobile, $whatsapp, $password);
        if ($result['success']) {
            // Update database and automatically redirect to dashboard on success
            header("Location: " . baseUrl('dashboard'));
            exit();
        } else {
            $error = $result['message'];
        }
    } else {
        $error = 'Please fill in all required fields.';
    }
}

    <script>
        function validateForm(event) {
            const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
            const confirmPassword = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;

            if (password !== "" && password !== confirmPassword) {
                alert("Passwords do not match! Please check again.");
                document.getElementById('confirmPassword').focus();
                event.preventDefault();
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    </script>
